+"""Pack a vision grid with start/newline/end embeddings, without index syncs."""
+
+import torch
+import triton
+import triton.language as tl
+
+
+@triton.jit(do_not_specialize=["rows", "width"])
+def _pack_vision_span(
+    F, START, NEWLINE, END, OUT, rows, width, D: tl.constexpr, B: tl.constexpr
+):
+    row = tl.program_id(0)
+    col = tl.program_id(1) * B + tl.arange(0, B)
+    inner = row - 1
+    patch = (row > 0) & (row < rows - 1) & (inner % (width + 1) < width)
+    src = (inner // (width + 1)) * width + inner % (width + 1)
+    value = tl.load(F + src * D + col, patch & (col < D), 0)
+    start = tl.load(START + col, (row == 0) & (col < D), 0)
+    end = tl.load(END + col, (row == rows - 1) & (col < D), 0)
+    newline = tl.load(
+        NEWLINE + col, (~patch) & (row > 0) & (row < rows - 1) & (col < D), 0
+    )
+    value = tl.where(
+        row == 0, start, tl.where(row == rows - 1, end, tl.where(patch, value, newline))
+    )
+    tl.store(OUT + row * D + col, value, col < D)
+
+
+def pack_vision_span(
+    features: torch.Tensor,
+    start: torch.Tensor,
+    newline: torch.Tensor,
+    end: torch.Tensor,
+    height: int,
+    width: int,
+) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """Pack [height * width, hidden] features in reading order, one newline per row.
+
+    The output is [2 + height * (width + 1), hidden]: ``start``, then each grid
+    row followed by ``newline``, then ``end``; it owns its storage.
+    """
+    if not (
+        height > 0
+        and width > 0
+        and features.is_cuda
+        and features.ndim == 2
+        and features.is_contiguous()
+        and features.shape[0] == height * width
+        and all(
+            v.device == features.device
+            and v.dtype == features.dtype
+            and v.is_contiguous()
+            and v.numel() == features.shape[1]
+            for v in (start, newline, end)
+        )
+    ):
+        raise ValueError("Unsupported vision span layout/grid")
+    rows, dim = 2 + height * (width + 1), features.shape[1]
+    out = torch.empty((rows, dim), dtype=features.dtype, device=features.device)
+    with torch.cuda.device(features.device):
+        _pack_vision_span[(rows, triton.cdiv(dim, 512))](
+            features, start, newline, end, out, rows, width, dim, 512
+        )
+    return out

+"""Split-K grouped FP8 block-[32, 32] wo_a projection of DeepSeek-V4.1 for a few rows.
+
+SM90 DeepGEMM has no split-K, so a few rows leave most SMs idle. This kernel
+splits K = 4096 into 8 slices per (group, 64 output columns) tile and sums the
+fp32 slice partials in slice order (deterministic).
+"""
+
+import torch
+import triton
+import triton.language as tl
+
+_BLOCK_M, _BLOCK_N, _BLOCK_K, _SPLIT_K = 16, 64, 256, 8
+
+
+@triton.jit
+def _wo_a_small_rows_kernel(
+    A,
+    AS,
+    B,
+    BS,
+    C,
+    P,
+    M,
+    S_T,
+    K: tl.constexpr,
+    R: tl.constexpr,
+    N: tl.constexpr,
+    BLOCK_M: tl.constexpr,
+    BLOCK_N: tl.constexpr,
+    BLOCK_K: tl.constexpr,
+    SPLIT_K: tl.constexpr,
+):
+    # Power-of-two scales make the bf16 dequant of both FP8 tiles exact, so the bf16
+    # dot over wide K tiles forms the same products as the 32-wide scaled FP8 dots.
+    pid_n, pid_m, pid_k = tl.program_id(0), tl.program_id(1), tl.program_id(2)
+    group = pid_n * BLOCK_N // R
+    KB: tl.constexpr = BLOCK_K // 32

+  N side. Gluon tensors are power-of-two shaped, so a token tile is one or two
+  pieces (48 = 32 + 16, 96 = 64 + 32), each with its own accumulator, instead
+  of padding 48 / 96 rows to a 64 / 128-row wgmma.

+  under PDL it issues the weight loads before waiting on the previous kernel.
+  The consumer warpgroup alternates two partial banks so the promotion of
+  group g overlaps the wgmmas of group g + 1; several small CTAs share an SM.

+  accumulator-fragment order to scratch, and the last CTA to arrive on the
+  tile's counter sums the partials in split order (deterministic), stores
+  bf16 and re-zeroes the counter for the next call.

+  [g * group_n, (g + 1) * group_n) multiply activation columns [g * K, (g + 1) * K),
+  so a CTA only offsets its token loads; the per-element arithmetic is unchanged.

+    o1_smem.store(gl.permute(acc1.to(gl.bfloat16), (1, 0)))

+        o2_smem.store(gl.permute(acc2.to(gl.bfloat16), (1, 0)))

+    gl.barrier()

+    if BT2 > 0:
+        tma.async_copy_shared_to_global(o2_desc, [t0 + BT1, w0], o2_smem)
+    tma.store_wait(0)

+@gluon.jit
+def _block32_swapab_kernel(
+    w_desc,
+    x1_desc,
+    x2_desc,
+    s1_desc,
+    s2_desc,
+    o1_desc,
+    o2_desc,
+    sw_ptr,
+    part_ptr,
+    cnt_ptr,
+    N,
+    KG: gl.constexpr,
+    BT1: gl.constexpr,
+    BT2: gl.constexpr,
+    STAGES: gl.constexpr,
+    SPLIT: gl.constexpr,
+    PRODUCER_REGS: gl.constexpr,
+    PDL: gl.constexpr,
+    GROUP_N: gl.constexpr,
+    num_warps: gl.constexpr,
+):
+    NKB: gl.constexpr = (KG + 3) // 4
+    TAIL: gl.constexpr = KG % 4
+    mma1_l: gl.constexpr = gl.NVMMADistributedLayout(
+        version=[3, 0], warps_per_cta=[num_warps, 1], instr_shape=[16, BT1, 32]
+    )
+    if BT2 > 0:
+        mma2_l: gl.constexpr = gl.NVMMADistributedLayout(
+            version=[3, 0], warps_per_cta=[num_warps, 1], instr_shape=[16, BT2, 32]
+        )
+    else:
+        mma2_l: gl.constexpr = mma1_l
+
+    pid_w = gl.program_id(0)
+    pid_t = gl.program_id(1)
+    pid_s = gl.program_id(2)
+    w0 = pid_w * _BW
+    t0 = pid_t * (BT1 + BT2)
+    if GROUP_N > 0:
+        # First 128-wide token K block of this CTA's group (K % 128 == 0 when grouped).
+        kg0 = (w0 // GROUP_N) * NKB
+    else:
+        kg0 = 0
+    kb_lo = pid_s * NKB // SPLIT
+    kb_hi = (pid_s + 1) * NKB // SPLIT
+    n_kb = kb_hi - kb_lo
+    has_tail = (TAIL > 0) & (kb_hi == NKB)
+
+    w_smem = gl.allocate_shared_memory(gl.float8e4nv, [STAGES, _BW, _BK], w_desc.layout)
+    x1_smem = gl.allocate_shared_memory(
+        gl.float8e4nv, [STAGES, BT1, _BK], x1_desc.layout
+    )
+    s1_smem = gl.allocate_shared_memory(gl.float32, [STAGES, 4, BT1], s1_desc.layout)
+    o1_smem = gl.allocate_shared_memory(gl.bfloat16, [BT1, _BW], o1_desc.layout)
+    if BT2 > 0:
+        x2_smem = gl.allocate_shared_memory(
+            gl.float8e4nv, [STAGES, BT2, _BK], x2_desc.layout
+        )
+        s2_smem = gl.allocate_shared_memory(
+            gl.float32, [STAGES, 4, BT2], s2_desc.layout
+        )
+        o2_smem = gl.allocate_shared_memory(gl.bfloat16, [BT2, _BW], o2_desc.layout)
+    else:
+        x2_smem = x1_smem
+        s2_smem = s1_smem
+        o2_smem = o1_smem
+    ready = mbarrier.allocate_mbarrier(batch=STAGES)
+    empty = mbarrier.allocate_mbarrier(batch=STAGES)
+    for s in gl.static_range(STAGES):
+        mbarrier.init(ready.index(s), count=1)
+        mbarrier.init(empty.index(s), count=1)

+    offs_w = w0 + gl.arange(0, _BW, layout=gl.SliceLayout(1, mma1_l))

+        [
+            (
+                _consumer,
+                (
+                    w_smem,
+                    x1_smem,
+                    x2_smem,
+                    s1_smem,
+                    s2_smem,
+                    ready,
+                    empty,
+                    sw_ptr,
+                    sw_offs,
+                    kb_lo,
+                    n_kb,
+                    has_tail,
+                    KG,
+                    BT1,
+                    BT2,
+                    STAGES,
+                    TAIL,
+                    mma1_l,
+                    mma2_l,
+                ),
+            ),
+            (
+                _producer,
+                (
+                    w_desc,
+                    x1_desc,
+                    x2_desc,
+                    s1_desc,
+                    s2_desc,
+                    w_smem,
+                    x1_smem,
+                    x2_smem,
+                    s1_smem,
+                    s2_smem,
+                    ready,
+                    empty,
+                    w0,
+                    t0,
+                    kb_lo,
+                    n_kb,
+                    kg0,
+                    BT1,
+                    BT2,
+                    STAGES,
+                    PDL,
+                ),
+            ),
+        ],
+        [1],
+        [PRODUCER_REGS],
+    )
+
+    if SPLIT == 1:
+        _tma_store_tile(
+            acc1, acc2, o1_smem, o2_smem, o1_desc, o2_desc, t0, w0, BT1, BT2
+        )
+    else:
+        REGION: gl.constexpr = _BW * (BT1 + BT2)
+        tile = pid_w * gl.num_programs(1) + pid_t
+        tbase = part_ptr + tile.to(gl.int64) * (SPLIT * REGION)
+        f1 = _frag_offs(BT1, mma1_l)
+        gl.store(tbase + pid_s * REGION + f1, acc1)
+        if BT2 > 0:
+            f2 = _BW * BT1 + _frag_offs(BT2, mma2_l)
+            gl.store(tbase + pid_s * REGION + f2, acc2)
+        gl.barrier()
+        cnt = gl.atomic_add(cnt_ptr + tile, 1, sem="acq_rel", scope="gpu")
+        if cnt == SPLIT - 1:
+            gl.barrier()

+            for sidx in gl.static_range(1, SPLIT):
+                tot1 += gl.load(tbase + sidx * REGION + f1, cache_modifier=".cg")
+            if BT2 > 0:
+                tot2 = gl.load(tbase + f2, cache_modifier=".cg")

+                    tot2 += gl.load(tbase + sidx * REGION + f2, cache_modifier=".cg")
+            else:
+                tot2 = tot1
+            _tma_store_tile(
+                tot1, tot2, o1_smem, o2_smem, o1_desc, o2_desc, t0, w0, BT1, BT2

+            gl.store(cnt_ptr + tile, 0)
+

+_layouts = {}

+
+def _smem_layout(rows: int, cols: int, dtype) -> gl.NVMMASharedLayout:
+    key = (rows, cols, dtype)
+    if key not in _layouts:

+_SCALE_LAYOUT = gl.NVMMASharedLayout(swizzle_byte_width=0, element_bitwidth=32, rank=2)

+def num_tiles(n: int, m: int, bt1: int, bt2: int) -> int:
+    return triton.cdiv(n, BLOCK_W) * triton.cdiv(m, bt1 + bt2)

+    else:
+        assert q.shape[1] == k

+        weight, [BLOCK_W, 128], _smem_layout(BLOCK_W, 128, gl.float8e4nv)
+    )
+    x1_desc = TensorDescriptor.from_tensor(
+        q, [bt1, 128], _smem_layout(bt1, 128, gl.float8e4nv)
+    )

+    )

+        x2_desc = TensorDescriptor.from_tensor(
+            q, [bt2, 128], _smem_layout(bt2, 128, gl.float8e4nv)
+        )
+        s2_desc = TensorDescriptor.from_tensor(x_scale_t, [4, bt2], _SCALE_LAYOUT)
+        o2_desc = TensorDescriptor.from_tensor(
+            out, [bt2, BLOCK_W], _smem_layout(bt2, BLOCK_W, gl.bfloat16)
+        )
+    else:
+        x2_desc, s2_desc, o2_desc = x1_desc, s1_desc, o1_desc
+    grid = (triton.cdiv(n, BLOCK_W), triton.cdiv(m, bt1 + bt2), split)
+    if split > 1:
+        assert counters is not None and counters.numel() >= grid[0] * grid[1]
+        part = torch.empty(
+            (grid[0] * grid[1] * split * BLOCK_W * (bt1 + bt2),),
+            dtype=torch.float32,

+        counters = x_scale

+        w_desc,
+        x1_desc,
+        x2_desc,
+        s1_desc,
+        s2_desc,
+        o1_desc,
+        o2_desc,
+        weight_scale,
+        part,
+        counters,
+        n,
+        KG=k // 32,
+        BT1=bt1,
+        BT2=bt2,
+        STAGES=stages,
+        SPLIT=split,
+        PRODUCER_REGS=24,
+        PDL=pdl,
+        GROUP_N=group_n,
+        num_warps=4,
+        maxnreg=maxnreg,
+        launch_pdl=pdl,
+    )
+    return out

+class SwapABConfig(msgspec.Struct, frozen=True):
+    # Token tile = bt1 + bt2 rows, each a power of two (bt2 may be 0).
+    bt1: int
+    bt2: int
+    stages: int
+    split: int
+    # Register cap per thread; sets how many CTAs share an SM.
+    maxnreg: int

+SwapABTable = Dict[Tuple[int, ...], Tuple[Tuple[int, Optional[SwapABConfig]], ...]]

+def parse_swapab_table(raw: Dict[str, Dict[str, Optional[dict]]]) -> SwapABTable:
+    table = {}
+    for shape, rows in raw.items():
+        n_part, k_part, *g_part = shape.split(",")
+        n = int(n_part.removeprefix("N="))
+        k = int(k_part.removeprefix("K="))
+        groups = int(g_part[0].removeprefix("G=")) if g_part else 1
+        if groups > 1 and (n % BLOCK_W or k % 128):
+            raise ValueError(
+                f"{shape}: grouped tiles need N % {BLOCK_W} == 0 and K % 128 == 0"
+            )
+        entries = sorted(
+            (int(m), None if cfg is None else msgspec.convert(cfg, SwapABConfig))
+            for m, cfg in rows.items()
+        )
+        for m, cfg in entries:
+            if cfg is None:
+                continue
+            for bt in (cfg.bt1, cfg.bt2):
+                if bt and (bt < 8 or bt > 128 or bt & (bt - 1)):
+                    raise ValueError(
+                        f"{shape} M={m}: token tile {bt} is not a power of two in [8, 128]"
+                    )
+            if cfg.split < 1 or cfg.split > (k // 32 + 3) // 4:
+                raise ValueError(
+                    f"{shape} M={m}: split {cfg.split} exceeds the K blocks"
+                )
+            if groups > 1 and cfg.split != 1:
+                raise ValueError(f"{shape} M={m}: grouped entries run split 1")
+        table[(n, k) if groups == 1 else (n, k, groups)] = tuple(entries)
+    return table
+
+
+def _read_swapab_table(path: Optional[str]) -> SwapABTable:
+    if path is None:
+        return {}
+    with open(path) as f:
+        return parse_swapab_table(json.load(f))
+

+@functools.lru_cache(maxsize=None)
+def load_swapab_table(device_name: str, role: str) -> SwapABTable:
+    """The device's table with the role's rows (mix / prefill / decode) layered
+    over it; empty when the device was not measured."""
+    table = _read_swapab_table(find_tuned_config("block32_swapab", device_name))
+    rows = _read_swapab_table(
+        find_tuned_config("block32_swapab", device_name, suffix=f",{role}")
+    )
+    return {**table, **rows}
+
+
+def lookup_swapab(
+    table: SwapABTable, n: int, k: int, m: int, groups: int = 1
+) -> Optional[SwapABConfig]:
+    """The entry at the smallest listed row count >= m; None past the largest
+    listed row count, for an unlisted shape, or where DeepGEMM was faster."""
+    rows = table.get((n, k) if groups == 1 else (n, k, groups))
+    if not rows or m <= 0 or m > rows[-1][0]:
+        return None
+    return next(cfg for row_m, cfg in rows if row_m >= m)

+"""SM90 FP8 LM-head GEMM, swap-AB, block-[128, 128] recipe (Gluon).
+
+    out[m, n] = bf16(sum_kb sa[m, kb] * sw[n // 128, kb] * dot128(x[m, 128kb:], w[n, 128kb:]))
+
+Per output element the arithmetic is DeepGEMM sm90_fp8_gemm_1d2d's: a fresh
+fp32 wgmma partial over each 128-wide K block (four k=32 wgmmas), promoted in
+K order as acc = fma.rn(mul.rn(sa, sw), partial, acc), then one bf16 rounding.
+
+Weight rows are the wgmma M side (64 per consumer warpgroup), token rows the
+N side, so a token tile is one or two power-of-two pieces (80 = 64 + 16,
+160 = 128 + 32) instead of DeepGEMM's 64 / 128 / 256-row tiles. Token tiles of
+one weight tile are adjacent in the grid so the weight streams from HBM once.
+One producer warp streams weight / token / scale stages with TMA; the consumer
+alternates two partial banks so the promotion of block kb overlaps the wgmmas
+of block kb + 1.
+
+The block-[32, 32] kernel in fp8_block32_swapab.py promotes every 32-wide K
+group instead, which rounds differently; the two share only their helpers.

+import triton
+from triton.experimental import gluon
+from triton.experimental.gluon import language as gl
+from triton.experimental.gluon.language.nvidia.hopper import (
+    fence_async_shared,
+    mbarrier,
+    tma,
+    warpgroup_mma,
+    warpgroup_mma_wait,
+)

+# K per TMA stage and per scale block.
+_BK = gl.constexpr(128)
+# TMA writes shared memory at 128-byte granularity: a stage's token scales
+# take at least 32 fp32 slots, the extra ones unused.
+_MIN_SCALE_COLS = 32

+@gluon.jit
+def _load_tokens(
+    x1_desc,
+    x2_desc,
+    s1_desc,
+    s2_desc,
+    x1_smem,
+    x2_smem,
+    s1_smem,
+    s2_smem,
+    bar,
+    stage,
+    kb,
+    t0,
+    BT1: gl.constexpr,
+    BT2: gl.constexpr,
+):
+    tma.async_copy_global_to_shared(x1_desc, [t0, kb * _BK], bar, x1_smem.index(stage))
+    tma.async_copy_global_to_shared(s1_desc, [kb, t0], bar, s1_smem.index(stage))
+    if BT2 > 0:
+        tma.async_copy_global_to_shared(
+            x2_desc, [t0 + BT1, kb * _BK], bar, x2_smem.index(stage)
+        )
+        tma.async_copy_global_to_shared(
+            s2_desc, [kb, t0 + BT1], bar, s2_smem.index(stage)
+        )
+
+
+@gluon.jit
+def _producer(
+    w_desc,
+    x1_desc,
+    x2_desc,
+    s1_desc,
+    s2_desc,
+    w_smem,
+    x1_smem,
+    x2_smem,
+    s1_smem,
+    s2_smem,
+    ready,
+    empty,
+    w0,
+    t0,
+    KB: gl.constexpr,
+    BW: gl.constexpr,
+    BT1: gl.constexpr,
+    BT2: gl.constexpr,
+    STAGES: gl.constexpr,
+    PDL: gl.constexpr,
+):
+    SC1: gl.constexpr = s1_desc.block_type.shape[1]
+    SC2: gl.constexpr = s2_desc.block_type.shape[1] if BT2 > 0 else 0
+    NBYTES: gl.constexpr = (BW + BT1 + BT2) * _BK + 4 * (SC1 + SC2)
+    j0 = 0
+    if PDL:
+        # Weights do not depend on the previous kernel: start streaming them,
+        # then wait for it before touching the activation and its scales.
+        for s in gl.static_range(STAGES):
+            if s < KB:
+                mbarrier.expect(ready.index(s), NBYTES)
+                tma.async_copy_global_to_shared(
+                    w_desc, [w0, s * _BK], ready.index(s), w_smem.index(s)
+                )
+        _gdc_wait()
+        for s in gl.static_range(STAGES):
+            if s < KB:
+                _load_tokens(
+                    x1_desc,
+                    x2_desc,
+                    s1_desc,
+                    s2_desc,
+                    x1_smem,
+                    x2_smem,
+                    s1_smem,
+                    s2_smem,
+                    ready.index(s),
+                    s,
+                    s,
+                    t0,
+                    BT1,
+                    BT2,
+                )
+        j0 = STAGES
+    for j in range(j0, KB):
+        stage = j % STAGES
+        if j >= STAGES:
+            mbarrier.wait(empty.index(stage), ((j // STAGES) - 1) & 1)
+            # Generic -> async proxy fence: a consumer warp's ld.shared of this
+            # stage's scales may still be pending; the TMA refill must not overtake it.
+            fence_async_shared()
+        bar = ready.index(stage)
+        mbarrier.expect(bar, NBYTES)
+        tma.async_copy_global_to_shared(w_desc, [w0, j * _BK], bar, w_smem.index(stage))
+        _load_tokens(
+            x1_desc,
+            x2_desc,
+            s1_desc,
+            s2_desc,
+            x1_smem,
+            x2_smem,
+            s1_smem,
+            s2_smem,
+            bar,
+            stage,
+            j,
+            t0,
+            BT1,
+            BT2,
+        )
+
+
+@gluon.jit
+def _issue_block(w_t, x1_t, x2_t, q1, q2, BT2: gl.constexpr):
+    # Four k=32 wgmmas accumulate one 128-wide K block into a fresh bank.
+    for sub in gl.static_range(4):
+        q1 = warpgroup_mma(
+            w_t.slice(sub * 32, 32, dim=1),
+            x1_t.slice(sub * 32, 32, dim=1).permute((1, 0)),
+            q1,
+            use_acc=sub > 0,
+            is_async=True,
+        )
+        if BT2 > 0:
+            q2 = warpgroup_mma(
+                w_t.slice(sub * 32, 32, dim=1),
+                x2_t.slice(sub * 32, 32, dim=1).permute((1, 0)),
+                q2,
+                use_acc=sub > 0,
+                is_async=True,
+            )
+    return q1, q2
+
+
+@gluon.jit
+def _wait_bank(q1, q2, pending: gl.constexpr, BT2: gl.constexpr):
+    if BT2 > 0:
+        q1, q2 = warpgroup_mma_wait(pending, deps=[q1, q2])
+    else:
+        q1 = warpgroup_mma_wait(pending, deps=[q1])
+    return q1, q2
+
+
+@gluon.jit
+def _load_sa(s_t, BT: gl.constexpr, col_l: gl.constexpr):
+    # [1, BT] row of the staged scales in the accumulator layout; the size-1
+    # reduction lands it in the column slice layout without a shuffle.
+    return gl.max(s_t.slice(0, BT, dim=1).load(col_l.parent), axis=0)
+
+
+@gluon.jit
+def _promote_block(
+    acc1,
+    acc2,
+    p1,
+    p2,
+    s1_t,
+    s2_t,
+    sw,
+    BT1: gl.constexpr,
+    BT2: gl.constexpr,
+    col1_l: gl.constexpr,
+    col2_l: gl.constexpr,
+):
+    # One weight-scale block per CTA: its rows sit in one 128-row block.
+    s1, _ = gl.broadcast((_load_sa(s1_t, BT1, col1_l) * sw)[None, :], p1)
+    acc1 = gl.fma(s1, p1, acc1)
+    if BT2 > 0:
+        s2, _ = gl.broadcast((_load_sa(s2_t, BT2, col2_l) * sw)[None, :], p2)
+        acc2 = gl.fma(s2, p2, acc2)
+    return acc1, acc2
+
+
+@gluon.jit
+def _release(empty, stage):
+    # Every warp has issued this stage's scale reads and its wgmmas retired;
+    # the producer proxy-fences before the refill.
+    gl.barrier()
+    mbarrier.arrive(empty.index(stage), count=1)
+
+
+@gluon.jit
+def _consumer(
+    w_smem,
+    x1_smem,
+    x2_smem,
+    s1_smem,
+    s2_smem,
+    ready,
+    empty,
+    sw_ptr,
+    sw_row,
+    KB: gl.constexpr,
+    BW: gl.constexpr,
+    BT1: gl.constexpr,
+    BT2: gl.constexpr,
+    STAGES: gl.constexpr,
+    mma1_l: gl.constexpr,
+    mma2_l: gl.constexpr,
+):
+    col1_l: gl.constexpr = gl.SliceLayout(0, mma1_l)
+    col2_l: gl.constexpr = gl.SliceLayout(0, mma2_l)
+    BT2S: gl.constexpr = BT2 if BT2 > 0 else 8
+    # Groups in flight behind a bank: one per wgmma call.
+    PENDING: gl.constexpr = 4 * (2 if BT2 > 0 else 1)
+    acc1 = gl.zeros([BW, BT1], gl.float32, layout=mma1_l)
+    a1 = acc1
+    b1 = acc1
+    acc2 = gl.zeros([BW, BT2S], gl.float32, layout=mma2_l)
+    a2 = acc2
+    b2 = acc2
+    # KB is even: block 2i accumulates in bank a, block 2i + 1 in bank b.
+    mbarrier.wait(ready.index(0), 0)
+    a1, a2 = _issue_block(
+        w_smem.index(0), x1_smem.index(0), x2_smem.index(0), a1, a2, BT2
+    )
+    sw_a = gl.load(sw_ptr + sw_row)
+    for i in range(KB // 2 - 1):
+        jb = 2 * i + 1
+        ja = jb + 1
+        sb = jb % STAGES
+        sa = ja % STAGES
+        sp = (jb - 1) % STAGES
+        sw_b = gl.load(sw_ptr + sw_row + jb)
+        mbarrier.wait(ready.index(sb), (jb // STAGES) & 1)
+        b1, b2 = _issue_block(
+            w_smem.index(sb), x1_smem.index(sb), x2_smem.index(sb), b1, b2, BT2
+        )
+        a1, a2 = _wait_bank(a1, a2, PENDING, BT2)
+        acc1, acc2 = _promote_block(
+            acc1,
+            acc2,
+            a1,
+            a2,
+            s1_smem.index(sp),
+            s2_smem.index(sp),
+            sw_a,
+            BT1,
+            BT2,
+            col1_l,
+            col2_l,
+        )
+        _release(empty, sp)
+        sw_a = gl.load(sw_ptr + sw_row + ja)
+        mbarrier.wait(ready.index(sa), (ja // STAGES) & 1)
+        a1, a2 = _issue_block(
+            w_smem.index(sa), x1_smem.index(sa), x2_smem.index(sa), a1, a2, BT2
+        )
+        b1, b2 = _wait_bank(b1, b2, PENDING, BT2)
+        acc1, acc2 = _promote_block(
+            acc1,
+            acc2,
+            b1,
+            b2,
+            s1_smem.index(sb),
+            s2_smem.index(sb),
+            sw_b,
+            BT1,
+            BT2,
+            col1_l,
+            col2_l,
+        )
+        _release(empty, sb)
+    jb = KB - 1
+    sb = jb % STAGES
+    sp = (jb - 1) % STAGES
+    sw_b = gl.load(sw_ptr + sw_row + jb)
+    mbarrier.wait(ready.index(sb), (jb // STAGES) & 1)
+    b1, b2 = _issue_block(
+        w_smem.index(sb), x1_smem.index(sb), x2_smem.index(sb), b1, b2, BT2
+    )
+    a1, a2 = _wait_bank(a1, a2, PENDING, BT2)
+    acc1, acc2 = _promote_block(
+        acc1,
+        acc2,
+        a1,
+        a2,
+        s1_smem.index(sp),
+        s2_smem.index(sp),
+        sw_a,
+        BT1,
+        BT2,
+        col1_l,
+        col2_l,
+    )
+    _release(empty, sp)
+    b1, b2 = _wait_bank(b1, b2, 0, BT2)
+    acc1, acc2 = _promote_block(
+        acc1,
+        acc2,
+        b1,
+        b2,
+        s1_smem.index(sb),
+        s2_smem.index(sb),
+        sw_b,
+        BT1,
+        BT2,
+        col1_l,
+        col2_l,
+    )
+    _release(empty, sb)
+    return acc1, acc2
+
+
+@gluon.jit
+def _lm_head_swapab_kernel(
+    w_desc,
+    x1_desc,
+    x2_desc,
+    s1_desc,
+    s2_desc,
+    o1_desc,
+    o2_desc,
+    sw_ptr,
+    KB: gl.constexpr,
+    BT1: gl.constexpr,
+    BT2: gl.constexpr,
+    STAGES: gl.constexpr,
+    PRODUCER_REGS: gl.constexpr,
+    PDL: gl.constexpr,
+    num_warps: gl.constexpr,
+):
+    # One consumer warpgroup per 64 weight rows.
+    BW: gl.constexpr = num_warps * 16
+    mma1_l: gl.constexpr = gl.NVMMADistributedLayout(
+        version=[3, 0], warps_per_cta=[num_warps, 1], instr_shape=[16, BT1, 32]
+    )
+    if BT2 > 0:
+        mma2_l: gl.constexpr = gl.NVMMADistributedLayout(
+            version=[3, 0], warps_per_cta=[num_warps, 1], instr_shape=[16, BT2, 32]
+        )
+    else:
+        mma2_l: gl.constexpr = mma1_l
+
+    # Token tiles of one weight tile run back to back.
+    pid_t = gl.program_id(0)
+    pid_w = gl.program_id(1)
+    w0 = pid_w * BW
+    t0 = pid_t * (BT1 + BT2)
+
+    w_smem = gl.allocate_shared_memory(gl.float8e4nv, [STAGES, BW, _BK], w_desc.layout)
+    x1_smem = gl.allocate_shared_memory(
+        gl.float8e4nv, [STAGES, BT1, _BK], x1_desc.layout
+    )
+    s1_smem = gl.allocate_shared_memory(
+        gl.float32, [STAGES, 1, s1_desc.block_type.shape[1]], s1_desc.layout
+    )
+    o1_smem = gl.allocate_shared_memory(gl.bfloat16, [BT1, BW], o1_desc.layout)
+    if BT2 > 0:
+        x2_smem = gl.allocate_shared_memory(
+            gl.float8e4nv, [STAGES, BT2, _BK], x2_desc.layout
+        )
+        s2_smem = gl.allocate_shared_memory(
+            gl.float32, [STAGES, 1, s2_desc.block_type.shape[1]], s2_desc.layout
+        )
+        o2_smem = gl.allocate_shared_memory(gl.bfloat16, [BT2, BW], o2_desc.layout)
+    else:
+        x2_smem = x1_smem
+        s2_smem = s1_smem
+        o2_smem = o1_smem
+    ready = mbarrier.allocate_mbarrier(batch=STAGES)
+    empty = mbarrier.allocate_mbarrier(batch=STAGES)
+    for s in gl.static_range(STAGES):
+        mbarrier.init(ready.index(s), count=1)
+        mbarrier.init(empty.index(s), count=1)
+
+    sw_row = (w0 // 128) * KB
+
+    acc1, acc2 = gl.warp_specialize(
+        [
+            (
+                _consumer,
+                (
+                    w_smem,
+                    x1_smem,
+                    x2_smem,
+                    s1_smem,
+                    s2_smem,
+                    ready,
+                    empty,
+                    sw_ptr,
+                    sw_row,
+                    KB,
+                    BW,
+                    BT1,
+                    BT2,
+                    STAGES,
+                    mma1_l,
+                    mma2_l,
+                ),
+            ),
+            (
+                _producer,
+                (
+                    w_desc,
+                    x1_desc,
+                    x2_desc,
+                    s1_desc,
+                    s2_desc,
+                    w_smem,
+                    x1_smem,
+                    x2_smem,
+                    s1_smem,
+                    s2_smem,
+                    ready,
+                    empty,
+                    w0,
+                    t0,
+                    KB,
+                    BW,
+                    BT1,
+                    BT2,
+                    STAGES,
+                    PDL,
+                ),
+            ),
+        ],
+        [1],
+        [PRODUCER_REGS],
+    )
+    _tma_store_tile(acc1, acc2, o1_smem, o2_smem, o1_desc, o2_desc, t0, w0, BT1, BT2)
+
+
+def lm_head_swapab_gemm(
+    q: torch.Tensor,
+    x_scale: torch.Tensor,
+    weight: torch.Tensor,
+    weight_scale: torch.Tensor,
+    out: torch.Tensor,
+    *,
+    block_w: int,
+    bt1: int,
+    bt2: int,
+    stages: int,
+    maxnreg: int,
+) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """q [M, K] e4m3, x_scale its MN-major fp32 view [M, K / 128] (strides
+    (1, padded M), padded M % 4 == 0), weight [N, K] e4m3 with N % 128 == 0,
+    weight_scale [N / 128, K / 128] fp32 contiguous -> ``out`` [M, N] bf16.
+    ``block_w``: weight rows per CTA, 64 or 128 (one consumer warpgroup each 64)."""
+    m, k = q.shape
+    n = weight.shape[0]
+    assert block_w in (64, 128) and n % 128 == 0 and k % 256 == 0, (block_w, n, k)
+    assert (
+        tuple(weight_scale.shape) == (n // 128, k // 128)
+        and weight_scale.is_contiguous()
+    )
+    x_scale_t = x_scale.t()
+    w_desc = TensorDescriptor.from_tensor(
+        weight, [block_w, 128], _smem_layout(block_w, 128, gl.float8e4nv)
+    )
+    x1_desc = TensorDescriptor.from_tensor(
+        q, [bt1, 128], _smem_layout(bt1, 128, gl.float8e4nv)
+    )
+    s1_desc = TensorDescriptor.from_tensor(
+        x_scale_t, [1, max(bt1, _MIN_SCALE_COLS)], _SCALE_LAYOUT
+    )
+    o1_desc = TensorDescriptor.from_tensor(
+        out, [bt1, block_w], _smem_layout(bt1, block_w, gl.bfloat16)
+    )
+    if bt2 > 0:
+        x2_desc = TensorDescriptor.from_tensor(
+            q, [bt2, 128], _smem_layout(bt2, 128, gl.float8e4nv)
+        )
+        s2_desc = TensorDescriptor.from_tensor(
+            x_scale_t, [1, max(bt2, _MIN_SCALE_COLS)], _SCALE_LAYOUT
+        )
+        o2_desc = TensorDescriptor.from_tensor(
+            out, [bt2, block_w], _smem_layout(bt2, block_w, gl.bfloat16)
+        )
+    else:
+        x2_desc, s2_desc, o2_desc = x1_desc, s1_desc, o1_desc
+    grid = (triton.cdiv(m, bt1 + bt2), n // block_w)
+    pdl = is_arch_support_pdl()
+    _lm_head_swapab_kernel[grid](
+        w_desc,
+        x1_desc,
+        x2_desc,
+        s1_desc,
+        s2_desc,
+        o1_desc,
+        o2_desc,
+        weight_scale,
+        KB=k // 128,
+        BT1=bt1,
+        BT2=bt2,
+        STAGES=stages,
+        PRODUCER_REGS=24,
+        PDL=pdl,
+        num_warps=block_w // 16,
+        maxnreg=maxnreg,
+        launch_pdl=pdl,
+    )
+    return out

+"""SM90 multi-row hc_mix stats for DeepSeek-V4.1, bitwise the split-K partials of
+``mhc.hc_mix_stats`` followed by the TileLang ``hc_split_sinkhorn``.
+
+The partials come from one of three kernels that write the same bits, picked by the
+row count: the production ``_hc_mix_stats_partial_kernel``, its tf32x3 dot written
+out (``_hc_mix_stats_partial_v2_kernel``), or the wgmma kernel in
+``mhc_mix_wgmma``. The reduce and the sinkhorn run in one Gluon kernel
+(``mhc_reduce_sinkhorn``). A row's bits therefore do not depend on the batch size,
+and the row thresholds, which the caller passes, move only time. The caller
+guarantees an SM90 device, where these lowerings were checked.
+"""
+
+from typing import Optional, Tuple
+
+import torch
+import triton
+import triton.language as tl
+
+from sglang.kernels.ops.layernorm.mhc import (
+    _HC_MIX_BLOCK_K,
+    _HC_MIX_DOT_PRECISION,
+    _HC_MIX_NUM_STAGES,
+    _HC_MIX_NUM_WARPS,
+    _block_m_for,
+    _hc_mix_stats_partial_kernel,
+    _num_slices_for,
+)
+
+_WGMMA_MAX_MIX = 32
+# Launch-only (like BLOCK_M); the fastest measured on H20 below the wgmma rows.
+_V2_NUM_WARPS = 4
+_V2_NUM_STAGES = 1
+
+
+@triton.jit
+def _tf32_rna(v):
+    # The rounding Triton's tf32x3 lowering (F32DotTC) applies to the "big" halves.
+    return tl.inline_asm_elementwise(
+        "cvt.rna.tf32.f32 $0, $1;",
+        "=r,r",
+        [v],
+        dtype=tl.float32,
+        is_pure=True,
+        pack=1,
+    )
+
+
+@triton.jit
+def _hc_mix_sq_tree64(x_ptr, offs_m, mask_m, x_stride_m, k0, BLOCK_M: tl.constexpr):
+    """sum(x[rows, k0:k0 + 64]^2) with the reduction tree the production kernel's
+    tl.sum lowers to on SM90 (x tile sizePerThread [1, 1], threadsPerWarp [1, 32],
+    two warps along K): per 32-wide half, lane 0's butterfly whose first stage is
+    contracted to fma(x_j, x_j, x_{j+16}^2), then offsets 8, 4, 2, 1, then the sum
+    of the two halves. Every step below is one fp32 add of two values (a size-2
+    sum), so the result does not depend on the layout Triton picks here."""
+    h = tl.arange(0, 2)
+    j = tl.arange(0, 16)
+    ptrs = (
+        x_ptr
+        + offs_m[:, None, None] * x_stride_m
+        + k0
+        + h[None, :, None] * 32
+        + j[None, None, :]
+    )
+    msk = mask_m[:, None, None]
+    own = tl.load(ptrs, mask=msk, other=0.0).to(tl.float32)
+    partner = tl.load(ptrs + 16, mask=msk, other=0.0).to(tl.float32)
+    a = tl.fma(own, own, partner * partner)
+    b = tl.sum(tl.reshape(a, (BLOCK_M, 2, 2, 8)), axis=2)
+    c = tl.sum(tl.reshape(b, (BLOCK_M, 2, 2, 4)), axis=2)
+    d = tl.sum(tl.reshape(c, (BLOCK_M, 2, 2, 2)), axis=2)
+    e = tl.sum(d, axis=2)
+    return tl.sum(e, axis=1)
+
+
+@triton.jit
+def _hc_mix_stats_partial_v2_kernel(
+    x_ptr,
+    w_ptr,
+    part_mix_ptr,
+    part_sq_ptr,
+    M,
+    K,
+    x_stride_m,
+    w_stride_n,
+    MIX: tl.constexpr,
+    MIX_PAD: tl.constexpr,
+    NUM_SLICES: tl.constexpr,
+    BLOCK_M: tl.constexpr,
+    BLOCK_K: tl.constexpr,
+    K_PER_SLICE: tl.constexpr,
+):
+    """``_hc_mix_stats_partial_kernel`` with its tf32x3 dot written out, for bf16 x.
+
+    On SM8x/9x Triton lowers dot(a, b, acc, "tf32x3") to
+        dot(aBig, bBig, nanz(dot(aBig, bSmall, dot(aSmall, bBig, 0)))) + acc
+    with xBig = cvt.rna.tf32(x) and xSmall = x - xBig. x is loaded from bf16, which
+    tf32 represents exactly, so aBig == x and aSmall == +0, and dot(+0, bBig, +0) is
+    +0 -- the same accumulator the aBig*bSmall chain starts from. Each output element
+    therefore sees the same mma.sync operands, chain order and rounding as the
+    production kernel for finite x and W (|W| below the tf32 overflow threshold);
+    non-finite inputs give non-finite outputs either way, possibly another inf/NaN.
+
+    x and W load through a constexpr slice offset (vectorized; K_PER_SLICE ==
+    K // NUM_SLICES, a BLOCK_K multiple), and the sum of squares is
+    ``_hc_mix_sq_tree64``, the production reduction tree spelled out.
+    """
+    tl.static_assert(BLOCK_K == 64, "_hc_mix_sq_tree64 spells out a 64-wide tile")
+    pid_m = tl.program_id(0)
+    slice_id = tl.program_id(1)
+    offs_m = pid_m * BLOCK_M + tl.arange(0, BLOCK_M)
+    offs_n = tl.arange(0, MIX_PAD)
+    mask_m = offs_m < M
+    mask_n = offs_n < MIX
+    k_per_slice = K // NUM_SLICES
+    acc = tl.zeros([BLOCK_M, MIX_PAD], dtype=tl.float32)
+    sq = tl.zeros([BLOCK_M], dtype=tl.float32)
+    for kb in tl.range(0, k_per_slice, BLOCK_K):
+        offs_k = slice_id * K_PER_SLICE + kb + tl.arange(0, BLOCK_K)
+        x_tile = tl.load(
+            x_ptr + offs_m[:, None] * x_stride_m + offs_k[None, :],
+            mask=mask_m[:, None],
+            other=0.0,
+        ).to(tl.float32)
+        w_tile = tl.load(
+            w_ptr + offs_n[None, :] * w_stride_n + offs_k[:, None],
+            mask=mask_n[None, :],
+            other=0.0,
+        ).to(tl.float32)
+        w_big = _tf32_rna(w_tile)
+        w_small = w_tile - w_big
+        d = tl.dot(x_tile, w_small, input_precision="tf32")
+        d = tl.where(d != d, 0.0, d)
+        d = tl.dot(x_tile, w_big, d, input_precision="tf32")
+        acc = d + acc
+        sq += _hc_mix_sq_tree64(
+            x_ptr, offs_m, mask_m, x_stride_m, slice_id * K_PER_SLICE + kb, BLOCK_M
+        )
+    tl.store(
+        part_mix_ptr + (slice_id * M + offs_m[:, None]) * MIX + offs_n[None, :],
+        acc,
+        mask=mask_m[:, None] & mask_n[None, :],
+    )
+    tl.store(part_sq_ptr + slice_id * M + offs_m, sq, mask=mask_m)
+
+
+def _wgmma_ok(x_flat: torch.Tensor, mix: int) -> bool:
+    # The wgmma kernel reads x as int32 words of bf16 pairs.
+    return (
+        mix <= _WGMMA_MAX_MIX
+        and x_flat.stride(0) % 2 == 0
+        and x_flat.storage_offset() % 2 == 0
+    )
+
+
+def hc_mix_partial_sm90(
+    x_flat: torch.Tensor,
+    hc_fn: torch.Tensor,
+    part_mix: torch.Tensor,
+    part_sq: torch.Tensor,
+    *,
+    v2_min_rows: Optional[int],
+    wgmma_min_rows: Optional[int],
+) -> None:
+    """Fill the split-K partials part_mix [S, M, MIX] and part_sq [S, M] of bf16
+    x_flat [M, K] and fp32 hc_fn [MIX, K], S = ``mhc._num_slices_for(K)``. The v2 and
+    wgmma kernels take the batches from their min rows on; None never takes them."""
+    m, k = x_flat.shape
+    mix = hc_fn.shape[0]
+    num_slices = part_mix.shape[0]
+    assert x_flat.dtype == torch.bfloat16 and hc_fn.dtype == torch.float32
+    assert x_flat.stride(1) == 1 and hc_fn.stride(1) == 1
+    assert num_slices == _num_slices_for(k)
+    if m == 0:
+        return
+    exact_slices = k % (num_slices * _HC_MIX_BLOCK_K) == 0
+    if (
+        wgmma_min_rows is not None
+        and m >= wgmma_min_rows
+        and exact_slices
+        and _wgmma_ok(x_flat, mix)
+    ):
+        from sglang.kernels.ops.layernorm.mhc_mix_wgmma import hc_mix_partial_wgmma
+
+        hc_mix_partial_wgmma(x_flat, hc_fn, part_mix, part_sq, num_slices, slice_w=True)
+        return
+    mix_pad = max(16, triton.next_power_of_2(mix))
+    block_m = _block_m_for(m)
+    grid = (triton.cdiv(m, block_m), num_slices)
+    if v2_min_rows is not None and m >= v2_min_rows and exact_slices:
+        _hc_mix_stats_partial_v2_kernel[grid](
+            x_flat,
+            hc_fn,
+            part_mix,
+            part_sq,
+            m,
+            k,
+            x_flat.stride(0),
+            hc_fn.stride(0),
+            MIX=mix,
+            MIX_PAD=mix_pad,
+            NUM_SLICES=num_slices,
+            BLOCK_M=block_m,
+            BLOCK_K=_HC_MIX_BLOCK_K,
+            K_PER_SLICE=k // num_slices,
+            num_warps=_V2_NUM_WARPS,
+            num_stages=_V2_NUM_STAGES,
+        )
+        return
+    _hc_mix_stats_partial_kernel[grid](
+        x_flat,
+        hc_fn,
+        part_mix,
+        part_sq,
+        m,
+        k,
+        x_flat.stride(0),
+        hc_fn.stride(0),
+        MIX=mix,
+        MIX_PAD=mix_pad,
+        NUM_SLICES=num_slices,
+        BLOCK_M=block_m,
+        BLOCK_K=_HC_MIX_BLOCK_K,
+        DOT_PRECISION=_HC_MIX_DOT_PRECISION,
+        num_warps=_HC_MIX_NUM_WARPS,
+        num_stages=_HC_MIX_NUM_STAGES,
+    )
+
+
+def hc_mix_stats_split_sinkhorn(
+    x_flat: torch.Tensor,
+    hc_fn: torch.Tensor,
+    hc_scale: torch.Tensor,
+    hc_base: torch.Tensor,
+    hc_mult: int,
+    sinkhorn_iters: int,
+    rms_eps: float,
+    hc_eps: float,
+    *,
+    v2_min_rows: Optional[int],
+    wgmma_min_rows: Optional[int],
+) -> Tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
+    """hc_split_sinkhorn(hc_mix_stats(x_flat, hc_fn, rms_eps)[:, None], ...) bit for bit
+    with the TileLang sinkhorn (SM90, HC=4, bf16 x_flat [M, K]). Returns pre [M, 4],
+    post [M, 4] and comb [M, 4, 4] fp32."""
+    from sglang.kernels.ops.layernorm.mhc_reduce_sinkhorn import (
+        hc_mix_reduce_sinkhorn,
+    )
+
+    assert x_flat.dim() == 2 and hc_fn.dim() == 2
+    m, k = x_flat.shape
+    mix = hc_fn.shape[0]
+    assert hc_mult == 4 and mix == (2 + hc_mult) * hc_mult and hc_fn.shape[1] == k
+    num_slices = _num_slices_for(k)
+    dev = x_flat.device
+    part_mix = torch.empty((num_slices, m, mix), dtype=torch.float32, device=dev)
+    part_sq = torch.empty((num_slices, m), dtype=torch.float32, device=dev)
+    hc_mix_partial_sm90(
+        x_flat,
+        hc_fn,
+        part_mix,
+        part_sq,
+        v2_min_rows=v2_min_rows,
+        wgmma_min_rows=wgmma_min_rows,
+    )
+    return hc_mix_reduce_sinkhorn(
+        part_mix,
+        part_sq,
+        hc_scale,
+        hc_base,
+        1.0 / k,
+        rms_eps,
+        sinkhorn_iters=sinkhorn_iters,
+        hc_eps=hc_eps,
+    )

+"""SM90 hc_mix_stats partial kernel on wgmma (Gluon), bitwise the production partials.
+
+Writes the same ``part_mix`` / ``part_sq`` as ``_hc_mix_stats_partial_kernel`` in
+``mhc.py`` (tf32x3 dot, 64-wide K tiles, K slices) for bf16 x:
+
+* Triton (3.7, 3.8) lowers the production tf32 dots to mma.sync m16n8k8 with the bf16 x
+  operand loaded through ldmatrix (kWidth 2), so k-step 2b of a 64-wide tile takes
+  the even columns of 16-column block b and k-step 2b + 1 the odd ones. The tensor
+  core's sum within one k-step does not depend on the order of its 8 products, and
+  wgmma m64n32k8 rounds like mma.sync for the same k-step column sets (both
+  measured bitwise on H20), so every output element here sees the same k-step sets
+  in the same chain order: dot(x, wSmall) from zero, NaN to zero, dot(x, wBig)
+  continuing from it, then ``acc = d + acc`` per 64-wide tile.
+* x is the wgmma A operand in registers: a 32-bit word of a bf16 pair is the even
+  column as ``w << 16`` and the odd one as ``w & 0xffff0000``, exact in fp32, so A
+  never goes through shared memory. W is split (cvt.rna.tf32) into shared memory
+  with its columns in the same k-step order.
+* The row sum of squares repeats the production reduction tree as size-2 sums.
+* Persistent CTAs walk (64-row tile, K slice) units; a CTA computes one slice of
+  one row tile at a time, so rows stay independent of the batch size.
+"""
+
+import torch
+import triton
+from triton.experimental import gluon
+from triton.experimental.gluon import language as gl
+from triton.experimental.gluon.language.nvidia.hopper import (
+    fence_async_shared,
+    warpgroup_mma,
+    warpgroup_mma_wait,
+)
+
+_BLOCK_M = 64
+_MIX_PAD = 32
+# Measured on H20: two CTAs per SM below 1024 rows; three with a 168-register cap
+# from 1024 rows (prefill chunks).
+_LARGE_M = 1024
+_CTAS_PER_SM = 2
+_CTAS_PER_SM_LARGE = 3
+_MAXNREG_LARGE = 168
+# A whole K slice of split W in shared memory: 2 x K / 64 tiles of [32, 64] fp32,
+# 64 KiB at 256, three CTAs per SM.
+_SLICE_W_MAX_K = 256
+
+
+@gluon.jit
+def _rna_tf32(v):
+    return gl.inline_asm_elementwise(
+        "cvt.rna.tf32.f32 $0, $1;",
+        "=r,r",
+        [v],
+        dtype=gl.float32,
+        is_pure=True,
+        pack=1,
+    )
+
+
+@gluon.jit
+def _load_x_words(xw_ptr, xw_stride, M, row0, kw0, valid, layout: gl.constexpr):
+    """[64, 32] int32 words (bf16 pairs) of rows row0.. and word columns kw0.."""
+    r = gl.arange(0, 64, layout=gl.SliceLayout(1, layout))
+    q = gl.arange(0, 32, layout=gl.SliceLayout(0, layout))
+    rows = (row0 + r)[:, None].to(gl.int64)
+    ptrs = xw_ptr + rows * xw_stride + kw0 + q[None, :]
+    return gl.load(ptrs, mask=((row0 + r < M) & valid)[:, None], other=0)
+
+
+@gluon.jit
+def _words_to_a(words, a_layout: gl.constexpr):
+    # Word q = 8b + 2t + p holds x columns 2q (low half) and 2q + 1 (high half);
+    # A column 16b + 8h + 4p + t (k-step 2b + h, slot 4p + t) takes half h of it.
+    lo = (words << 16).to(gl.float32, bitcast=True)
+    hi = (words & -65536).to(gl.float32, bitcast=True)
+    a = gl.reshape(gl.join(lo, hi), [64, 4, 4, 2, 2])
+    a = gl.reshape(gl.permute(a, (0, 1, 4, 3, 2)), [64, 64])
+    return gl.convert_layout(a, a_layout)
+
+
+@gluon.jit
+def _sq_tree64(a):
+    # Same adds as mhc._hc_mix_sq_tree64. A column 16(2g + beta) + 8h + 4p + 2t1 + t0
+    # is x column 32g + 16beta + j with j = 8t1 + 4t0 + 2p + h.
+    a = gl.permute(gl.reshape(a, [64, 2, 2, 16]), (0, 1, 3, 2))
+    own, partner = gl.split(a)
+    s = gl.fma(own, own, partner * partner)
+    s = gl.reshape(s, [64, 2, 2, 2, 2, 2])  # (g, h, p, t1, t0)
+    s = gl.sum(s, axis=4)  # j + (j + 8)
+    s = gl.sum(s, axis=4)  # j + (j + 4)
+    s = gl.sum(s, axis=3)  # j + (j + 2)
+    s = gl.sum(s, axis=2)  # j + (j + 1)
+    return gl.sum(s, axis=1)  # columns 0..31 + columns 32..63
+
+
+@gluon.jit
+def _load_w(
+    w_ptr,
+    w_stride_n,
+    k0,
+    valid,
+    MIX: gl.constexpr,
+    MIX_PAD: gl.constexpr,
+    layout: gl.constexpr,
+):
+    n = gl.arange(0, MIX_PAD, layout=gl.SliceLayout(1, layout))
+    k = gl.arange(0, 64, layout=gl.SliceLayout(0, layout))
+    ptrs = w_ptr + k0 + n[:, None] * w_stride_n + k[None, :]
+    return gl.load(ptrs, mask=((n < MIX) & valid)[:, None], other=0.0)
+
+
+@gluon.jit
+def _stage_w(w, w_small_buf, w_big_buf):
+    # W column 16b + 4t + 2p + h goes to B row 16b + 8h + 4p + t, the A column order.
+    NPAD: gl.constexpr = w.shape[0]
+    w = gl.permute(gl.reshape(w, [NPAD, 4, 4, 2, 2]), (0, 1, 4, 3, 2))
+    w = gl.reshape(w, [NPAD, 64])
+    w_big = _rna_tf32(w)
+    w_small_buf.store(w - w_big)
+    w_big_buf.store(w_big)
+    fence_async_shared()
+
+
+@gluon.jit
+def _hc_mix_partial_wgmma_kernel(
+    xw_ptr,
+    w_ptr,
+    part_mix_ptr,
+    part_sq_ptr,
+    M,
+    xw_stride,
+    w_stride_n,
+    n_units,
+    n_m_tiles,
+    MIX: gl.constexpr,
+    MIX_PAD: gl.constexpr,
+    K_PER_SLICE: gl.constexpr,
+    num_warps: gl.constexpr,
+):
+    BM: gl.constexpr = 64
+    BK: gl.constexpr = 64
+    T: gl.constexpr = K_PER_SLICE // BK
+    gl.static_assert(num_warps == 4)
+    gl.static_assert(K_PER_SLICE % BK == 0)
+    mma_layout: gl.constexpr = gl.NVMMADistributedLayout(
+        version=[3, 0], warps_per_cta=[num_warps, 1], instr_shape=[16, MIX_PAD, 8]
+    )
+    a_layout: gl.constexpr = gl.DotOperandLayout(
+        operand_index=0, parent=mma_layout, k_width=1
+    )
+    # a_layout with the two halves of each word (k-steps 2b and 2b + 1) folded,
+    # so a thread's bf16 pairs load as 8-byte vectors.
+    words_layout: gl.constexpr = gl.DistributedLinearLayout(
+        reg_bases=[[0, 1], [8, 0], [0, 8], [0, 16]],
+        lane_bases=[[0, 2], [0, 4], [1, 0], [2, 0], [4, 0]],
+        warp_bases=[[16, 0], [32, 0]],
+        block_bases=[],
+        shape=[64, 32],
+    )
+    w_layout: gl.constexpr = gl.BlockedLayout([1, 16], [8, 4], [num_warps, 1], [1, 0])
+    b_layout: gl.constexpr = gl.NVMMASharedLayout.get_default_for(
+        [MIX_PAD, BK], gl.float32
+    )
+    w_small_smem = gl.allocate_shared_memory(gl.float32, [2, MIX_PAD, BK], b_layout)
+    w_big_smem = gl.allocate_shared_memory(gl.float32, [2, MIX_PAD, BK], b_layout)
+
+    pid = gl.program_id(0)
+    grid = gl.num_programs(0)
+    u = pid
+    true = u >= 0
+    k0 = (u // n_m_tiles) * K_PER_SLICE
+    r0 = (u % n_m_tiles) * BM
+    xr = _load_x_words(xw_ptr, xw_stride, M, r0, k0 // 2, true, words_layout)
+    wr = _load_w(w_ptr, w_stride_n, k0, true, MIX, MIX_PAD, w_layout)
+    _stage_w(wr, w_small_smem.index(0), w_big_smem.index(0))
+    wr = _load_w(w_ptr, w_stride_n, k0 + BK, true, MIX, MIX_PAD, w_layout)
+    d = gl.zeros([BM, MIX_PAD], gl.float32, layout=mma_layout)
+    it = 0
+    while u < n_units:
+        sl = u // n_m_tiles
+        r0 = (u % n_m_tiles) * BM
+        kb = sl * K_PER_SLICE
+        un = u + grid
+        nv = un < n_units
+        rn = (un % n_m_tiles) * BM
+        kn = (un // n_m_tiles) * K_PER_SLICE
+        for t in gl.static_range(T):
+            buf = it % 2
+            a = _words_to_a(xr, a_layout)
+            if t + 1 < T:
+                kw = (kb + (t + 1) * BK) // 2
+                xr = _load_x_words(xw_ptr, xw_stride, M, r0, kw, true, words_layout)
+            else:
+                xr = _load_x_words(xw_ptr, xw_stride, M, rn, kn // 2, nv, words_layout)
+            gl.barrier()
+            small = warpgroup_mma(
+                a,
+                w_small_smem.index(buf).permute((1, 0)),
+                d,
+                use_acc=False,
+                is_async=True,
+            )
+            tile_sq = _sq_tree64(a)
+            if t == 0:
+                sq = tile_sq + 0.0
+            else:
+                sq = sq + tile_sq
+            d = warpgroup_mma_wait(0, deps=[small])
+            d = gl.where(d != d, 0.0, d)
+            big = warpgroup_mma(
+                a, w_big_smem.index(buf).permute((1, 0)), d, is_async=True
+            )
+            # The other buffer's last reader, the previous tile's big chain, retired.
+            _stage_w(wr, w_small_smem.index(1 - buf), w_big_smem.index(1 - buf))
+            if t + 2 < T:
+                kw = kb + (t + 2) * BK
+                wr = _load_w(w_ptr, w_stride_n, kw, true, MIX, MIX_PAD, w_layout)
+            else:
+                kw = kn + (t + 2 - T) * BK
+                wr = _load_w(w_ptr, w_stride_n, kw, nv, MIX, MIX_PAD, w_layout)
+            d = warpgroup_mma_wait(0, deps=[big])
+            if t == 0:
+                acc = d + 0.0
+            else:
+                acc = d + acc
+            it += 1
+        rows = r0 + gl.arange(0, BM, layout=gl.SliceLayout(1, mma_layout))
+        cols = gl.arange(0, MIX_PAD, layout=gl.SliceLayout(0, mma_layout))
+        gl.store(
+            part_mix_ptr + (sl * M + rows[:, None]) * MIX + cols[None, :],
+            acc,
+            mask=(rows < M)[:, None] & (cols < MIX)[None, :],
+        )
+        sq_rows = r0 + gl.arange(0, BM, layout=sq.type.layout)
+        gl.store(part_sq_ptr + sl * M + sq_rows, sq, mask=sq_rows < M)
+        u = un
+
+
+@gluon.jit
+def _hc_mix_partial_wgmma_slice_w_kernel(
+    xw_ptr,
+    w_ptr,
+    part_mix_ptr,
+    part_sq_ptr,
+    M,
+    xw_stride,
+    w_stride_n,
+    n_units,
+    n_m_tiles,
+    units_per_cta,
+    MIX: gl.constexpr,
+    MIX_PAD: gl.constexpr,
+    K_PER_SLICE: gl.constexpr,

+    BK: gl.constexpr = 64

+    gl.static_assert(K_PER_SLICE % BK == 0)

+    )

+        lane_bases=[[0, 2], [0, 4], [1, 0], [2, 0], [4, 0]],
+        warp_bases=[[16, 0], [32, 0]],
+        block_bases=[],
+        shape=[64, 32],
+    )

+    w_big_smem = gl.allocate_shared_memory(gl.float32, [T, MIX_PAD, BK], b_layout)
+
+    u = gl.program_id(0) * units_per_cta
+    u_end = gl.minimum(u + units_per_cta, n_units)

+    k_first = (u // n_m_tiles) * K_PER_SLICE

+            gl.barrier()

+                wr = _load_w(
+                    w_ptr, w_stride_n, kb + t * BK, true, MIX, MIX_PAD, w_layout
+                )
+                _stage_w(wr, w_small_smem.index(t), w_big_smem.index(t))
+            gl.barrier()

+        nv = un < u_end
+        rn = (un % n_m_tiles) * BM
+        kn = (un // n_m_tiles) * K_PER_SLICE
+        for t in gl.static_range(T):
+            a = _words_to_a(xr, a_layout)
+            if t + 1 < T:
+                kw = (kb + (t + 1) * BK) // 2
+                xr = _load_x_words(xw_ptr, xw_stride, M, r0, kw, true, words_layout)
+            else:
+                xr = _load_x_words(xw_ptr, xw_stride, M, rn, kn // 2, nv, words_layout)
+            small = warpgroup_mma(
+                a,
+                w_small_smem.index(t).permute((1, 0)),
+                d,
+                use_acc=False,
+                is_async=True,
+            )
+            tile_sq = _sq_tree64(a)
+            if t == 0:
+                sq = tile_sq + 0.0
+            else:
+                sq = sq + tile_sq
+            d = warpgroup_mma_wait(0, deps=[small])
+            d = gl.where(d != d, 0.0, d)
+            big = warpgroup_mma(
+                a, w_big_smem.index(t).permute((1, 0)), d, is_async=True
+            )
+            d = warpgroup_mma_wait(0, deps=[big])
+            if t == 0:
+                acc = d + 0.0
+            else:
+                acc = d + acc
+        rows = r0 + gl.arange(0, BM, layout=gl.SliceLayout(1, mma_layout))
+        cols = gl.arange(0, MIX_PAD, layout=gl.SliceLayout(0, mma_layout))
+        gl.store(
+            part_mix_ptr + (sl * M + rows[:, None]) * MIX + cols[None, :],
+            acc,
+            mask=(rows < M)[:, None] & (cols < MIX)[None, :],
+        )
+        sq_rows = r0 + gl.arange(0, BM, layout=sq.type.layout)
+        gl.store(part_sq_ptr + sl * M + sq_rows, sq, mask=sq_rows < M)
+        u = un
+
+
+_num_sms = {}
+
+
+def hc_mix_partial_wgmma(
+    x_flat: torch.Tensor,
+    hc_fn: torch.Tensor,
+    part_mix: torch.Tensor,
+    part_sq: torch.Tensor,
+    num_slices: int,
+    *,
+    slice_w: bool = False,
+) -> None:
+    """part_mix [num_slices, M, MIX] / part_sq [num_slices, M] of bf16 x_flat [M, K]
+    (even row stride and offset) and fp32 hc_fn [MIX <= 32, K]. ``slice_w`` stages
+    each K slice's W once per CTA from 1024 rows (same partials)."""
+    m, k = x_flat.shape
+    n_m_tiles = triton.cdiv(m, _BLOCK_M)
+    n_units = n_m_tiles * num_slices
+    device = x_flat.device.index
+    if device is None:
+        device = torch.cuda.current_device()
+    if device not in _num_sms:
+        _num_sms[device] = torch.cuda.get_device_properties(
+            device
+        ).multi_processor_count

+    ctas = _num_sms[device] * (_CTAS_PER_SM_LARGE if large else _CTAS_PER_SM)

+            hc_fn,
+            part_mix,
+            part_sq,
+            m,
+            xw.stride(0),
+            hc_fn.stride(0),
+            n_units,
+            n_m_tiles,
+            per_cta,
+            MIX=hc_fn.shape[0],
+            MIX_PAD=_MIX_PAD,
+            K_PER_SLICE=k_per_slice,
+            num_warps=4,
+            maxnreg=_MAXNREG_LARGE,
+        )

+    _hc_mix_partial_wgmma_kernel[(min(n_units, ctas),)](
+        xw,
+        hc_fn,
+        part_mix,
+        part_sq,
+        m,
+        xw.stride(0),
+        hc_fn.stride(0),
+        n_units,
+        n_m_tiles,
+        MIX=hc_fn.shape[0],
+        MIX_PAD=_MIX_PAD,
+        K_PER_SLICE=k // num_slices,
+        num_warps=4,
+        **({"maxnreg": _MAXNREG_LARGE} if large else {}),
+    )

+"""HC=4 post-mix fused with the next sublayer's pre-collapse (DeepSeek-V4.1).
+
+One launch computes ``R' = mhc_post(x, residual, post, comb)`` and
+``y = mhc_combine(R', pre)``. Each output element follows the exact operation
+sequence of the two kernels it replaces, so both outputs are bitwise identical:
+
+* ``R'`` repeats ``mhc_post_split_h`` (itself matched to the TileLang post kernel):
+  round ``comb[0] * residual[0]`` first, FMA ``post * x`` into it, then FMA the
+  remaining ``comb[i] * residual[i]`` terms in order, all in fp32; store BF16.
+* ``y`` repeats ``_mhc_combine_kernel`` on the BF16-rounded ``R'``: an fp32
+  accumulator starting at zero, ``acc += pre[k] * R'[k]`` for k = 0..3 in order,
+  compiled with the same (default) fp-fusion setting; store BF16.
+"""
+
+import torch
+import triton
+import triton.language as tl
+
+
+@triton.jit
+def _mhc_post_combine_kernel(
+    X,
+    R,
+    P,
+    C,
+    PRE,
+    Y,
+    OUT,
+    pre_stride_m,
+    pre_stride_k,
+    H: tl.constexpr,
+    B: tl.constexpr,
+):
+    token = tl.program_id(0)
+    h = tl.program_id(1) * B + tl.arange(0, B)
+    mask = h < H
+    x = tl.load(X + token * H + h, mask, 0).to(tl.float32)
+    r0 = tl.load(R + (token * 4 + 0) * H + h, mask, 0).to(tl.float32)
+    r1 = tl.load(R + (token * 4 + 1) * H + h, mask, 0).to(tl.float32)
+    r2 = tl.load(R + (token * 4 + 2) * H + h, mask, 0).to(tl.float32)
+    r3 = tl.load(R + (token * 4 + 3) * H + h, mask, 0).to(tl.float32)
+    acc_y = tl.zeros([B], dtype=tl.float32)
+    for o in tl.static_range(4):
+        # comb is [token, i, o]: residual stream i feeds output stream o.
+        acc = tl.fma(
+            tl.load(P + token * 4 + o),
+            x,
+            tl.load(C + token * 16 + 0 * 4 + o) * r0,
+        )
+        acc = tl.fma(tl.load(C + token * 16 + 1 * 4 + o), r1, acc)
+        acc = tl.fma(tl.load(C + token * 16 + 2 * 4 + o), r2, acc)
+        acc = tl.fma(tl.load(C + token * 16 + 3 * 4 + o), r3, acc)
+        out = acc.to(tl.bfloat16)
+        tl.store(OUT + (token * 4 + o) * H + h, out, mask)
+        pk = tl.load(PRE + token * pre_stride_m + o * pre_stride_k).to(tl.float32)
+        acc_y += pk * out.to(tl.float32)
+    tl.store(Y + token * H + h, acc_y, mask)
+
+
+def can_use_mhc_post_combine(x, residual, post, comb, pre) -> bool:
+    return (
+        x.is_cuda
+        and x.dim() == 2
+        and x.shape[1] == 5120
+        and residual.shape == (x.shape[0], 4, x.shape[1])
+        and x.dtype == residual.dtype == torch.bfloat16
+        and post.dtype == comb.dtype == pre.dtype == torch.float32
+        and post.numel() == x.shape[0] * 4
+        and comb.shape == (x.shape[0], 4, 4)
+        and pre.shape == (x.shape[0], 4)
+        and all(t.is_contiguous() for t in (x, residual, post, comb))
+    )
+
+
+def mhc_post_combine(x, residual, post, comb, pre):
+    """Returns (mhc_post(x, residual, post, comb), mhc_combine(that, pre)), bitwise."""
+    assert can_use_mhc_post_combine(x, residual, post, comb, pre)
+    m, hidden = x.shape
+    output = torch.empty_like(residual)
+    y = torch.empty((m, hidden), dtype=x.dtype, device=x.device)
+    if m == 0:
+        return output, y
+    block = 128 if m <= 8 else 1024
+    _mhc_post_combine_kernel[(m, triton.cdiv(hidden, block))](
+        x,
+        residual,
+        post,
+        comb,
+        pre,
+        y,
+        output,
+        pre.stride(0),
+        pre.stride(1),
+        H=hidden,
+        B=block,
+        num_warps=4,
+    )
+    return output, y

+"""HC=4 sublayer-input collapse and RMSNorm in one launch (DeepSeek-V4.1, H=5120).
+
+``mhc_post_combine_norm(x, residual, post, comb, pre, weight, eps)`` returns
+``(R', rmsnorm(mhc_combine(R', pre)))`` with
+``R' = mhc_post(x, residual, post, comb)``, bitwise ``mhc_post_combine`` followed by
+``RMSNorm.forward_cuda`` (FlashInfer's CuTe-DSL kernel).
+``mhc_combine_norm(residual, pre, weight, eps)`` is the same without the post-mix:
+bitwise ``mhc_combine`` followed by ``RMSNorm.forward_cuda``.
+"""
+
+import torch
+
+from sglang.kernels.jit.utils import cache_once, load_jit, make_cpp_args
+from sglang.srt.utils.custom_op import register_custom_op
+
+# Rows per CTA and vector blocks loaded together; any values give the same bits.
+# H20, 4096 rows post+combine+norm (cold L2): (2, 1) 148.6 us, (1, 5) 138.6 us.
+_ROWS_PER_CTA = 1
+_LOAD_GROUP = 5
+
+
+@cache_once
+def _module(rows_per_cta: int, load_group: int):
+    args = make_cpp_args(rows_per_cta, load_group)
+    return load_jit(
+        "dsv41_mhc_collapse_norm",
+        *args,
+        cuda_files=["deepseek_v4/mhc_post_combine_norm.cuh"],
+        cuda_wrappers=[
+            ("post_combine_norm", f"MhcCollapseNorm<{args}>::post_combine_norm"),
+            ("combine_norm", f"MhcCollapseNorm<{args}>::combine_norm"),
+        ],
+    )
+
+
+def can_use_mhc_post_combine_norm(x, residual, post, comb, pre, weight) -> bool:
+    return (
+        x.is_cuda
+        and x.dim() == 2
+        and x.shape[1] == 5120
+        and residual.shape == (x.shape[0], 4, 5120)
+        and x.dtype == residual.dtype == weight.dtype == torch.bfloat16
+        and post.dtype == comb.dtype == pre.dtype == torch.float32
+        and post.numel() == x.shape[0] * 4
+        and comb.shape == (x.shape[0], 4, 4)
+        and pre.shape == (x.shape[0], 4)
+        and weight.shape == (5120,)
+        and all(t.is_contiguous() for t in (x, residual, post, comb, weight))
+        and all(t.data_ptr() % 16 == 0 for t in (x, residual, weight))
+    )
+
+
+@register_custom_op(mutates_args=["residual_out", "normalized"])
+def _post_combine_norm_op(
+    x: torch.Tensor,
+    residual: torch.Tensor,
+    post: torch.Tensor,
+    comb: torch.Tensor,
+    pre: torch.Tensor,
+    weight: torch.Tensor,
+    residual_out: torch.Tensor,
+    normalized: torch.Tensor,
+    eps: float,
+) -> None:
+    _module(_ROWS_PER_CTA, _LOAD_GROUP).post_combine_norm(
+        x, residual, post, comb, pre, weight, residual_out, normalized, eps
+    )
+
+
+def mhc_post_combine_norm(x, residual, post, comb, pre, weight, eps: float):
+    assert can_use_mhc_post_combine_norm(x, residual, post, comb, pre, weight)
+    residual_out = torch.empty_like(residual)
+    normalized = torch.empty_like(x)
+    _post_combine_norm_op(
+        x,
+        residual,
+        post.view(x.shape[0], 4),
+        comb,
+        pre,
+        weight,
+        residual_out,
+        normalized,
+        eps,
+    )
+    return residual_out, normalized
+
+
+def can_use_mhc_combine_norm(residual, pre, weight) -> bool:
+    return (
+        residual.is_cuda
+        and residual.dim() == 3
+        and residual.shape[1:] == (4, 5120)
+        and residual.dtype == weight.dtype == torch.bfloat16
+        and pre.dtype == torch.float32
+        and pre.shape == (residual.shape[0], 4)
+        and weight.shape == (5120,)
+        and residual.is_contiguous()
+        and weight.is_contiguous()
+        and residual.data_ptr() % 16 == 0
+        and weight.data_ptr() % 16 == 0
+    )
+
+
+@register_custom_op(mutates_args=["normalized"])
+def _combine_norm_op(
+    residual: torch.Tensor,
+    pre: torch.Tensor,
+    weight: torch.Tensor,
+    normalized: torch.Tensor,
+    eps: float,
+) -> None:
+    _module(_ROWS_PER_CTA, _LOAD_GROUP).combine_norm(
+        residual, pre, weight, normalized, eps
+    )
+
+
+def mhc_combine_norm(residual, pre, weight, eps: float):
+    assert can_use_mhc_combine_norm(residual, pre, weight)
+    normalized = residual.new_empty(residual.shape[0], 5120)
+    _combine_norm_op(residual, pre, weight, normalized, eps)
+    return normalized

+"""Reduce + split-sinkhorn of hc_mix_stats in one SM90 kernel (Gluon), bitwise equal
+to ``_hc_mix_stats_reduce_kernel`` (Triton) followed by the TileLang
+``hc_split_sinkhorn_kernel`` (HC=4).
+
+* The slice sums keep the production order (0 + p0 + p1 + ... per element) and its
+  rms expression (fma, sqrt.approx, div.full).
+* In the sinkhorn each comb row of 4 sits on 4 consecutive lanes and each column on
+  lanes 4 apart, so gl.sum lowers to the shfl.bfly xor 2, 1 / xor 8, 4 trees of
+  TileLang's AllReduce.
+* exp, sigmoid and division are the PTX sequences nvcc emits for the TileLang
+  kernel (TileLang 0.1.12, nvcc 13.0, no fast-math), written out inline.
+* TileLang's 0 + x before each 4-element sum is skipped: every comb value is +0 or
+  more (or NaN), where adding +0 changes no bits.
+"""
+
+from typing import Optional, Tuple
+
+import torch
+import triton
+from triton.experimental import gluon
+from triton.experimental.gluon import language as gl
+
+
+@gluon.jit
+def _sigmoid_nvcc(t):
+    # nvcc: 1 / (1 + expf(0 - t)); libdevice expf with its final multiply
+    # contracted into the "+ 1" (fma.rn(ex2, 2^n, 1)), then rcp.rn.
+    return gl.inline_asm_elementwise(
+        """
+        {
+        .reg .f32 x, a, b, c, d, e, f, g;
+        .reg .b32 n;
+        mov.f32 a, 0f00000000;
+        sub.f32 x, a, $1;
+        fma.rn.f32 a, x, 0f3BBB989D, 0f3F000000;
+        cvt.sat.f32.f32 a, a;
+        fma.rm.f32 b, a, 0f437C0000, 0f4B400001;
+        add.f32 c, b, 0fCB40007F;
+        neg.f32 c, c;
+        fma.rn.f32 d, x, 0f3FB8AA3B, c;
+        fma.rn.f32 d, x, 0f32A57060, d;
+        mov.b32 n, b;
+        shl.b32 n, n, 23;
+        mov.b32 e, n;
+        ex2.approx.ftz.f32 f, d;
+        fma.rn.f32 g, f, e, 0f3F800000;
+        rcp.rn.f32 $0, g;
+        }
+        """,
+        "=r,r",
+        [t],
+        dtype=gl.float32,
+        is_pure=True,
+        pack=1,
+    )
+
+
+@gluon.jit
+def _expf_nvcc(x):
+    # libdevice expf (non-fast-math). mul.rn keeps ptxas from contracting the final
+    # multiply into the row-sum add that follows.
+    return gl.inline_asm_elementwise(
+        """
+        {
+        .reg .f32 a, b, c, d, e, f;
+        .reg .b32 n;
+        fma.rn.f32 a, $1, 0f3BBB989D, 0f3F000000;
+        cvt.sat.f32.f32 a, a;
+        fma.rm.f32 b, a, 0f437C0000, 0f4B400001;
+        add.f32 c, b, 0fCB40007F;
+        neg.f32 c, c;
+        fma.rn.f32 d, $1, 0f3FB8AA3B, c;
+        fma.rn.f32 d, $1, 0f32A57060, d;
+        mov.b32 n, b;
+        shl.b32 n, n, 23;
+        mov.b32 e, n;
+        ex2.approx.ftz.f32 f, d;
+        mul.rn.f32 $0, f, e;
+        }
+        """,
+        "=r,r",
+        [x],
+        dtype=gl.float32,
+        is_pure=True,
+        pack=1,
+    )
+
+

+
+
+@gluon.jit
+def _hc_mix_reduce_sinkhorn_tl_kernel(
+    part_mix_ptr,
+    part_sq_ptr,

+    base_ptr,
+    pre_ptr,
+    post_ptr,
+    comb_ptr,

+"""Block-32 ue8m0 activation quantization that writes DeepGEMM's SM90 scale layout.
+
+sglang_per_token_group_quant_fp8(x, 32, scale_ue8m0=True) writes row-major fp32
+power-of-two scales, which deep_gemm.fp8_gemm_nt(recipe=(1, 32, 32)) then copies
+into an MN-major, TMA-aligned buffer with a separate transpose launch. This kernel
+writes that buffer directly (and the same FP8 values), so DeepGEMM and the swap-AB
+GEMM use the scales as given. The per-group arithmetic repeats
+per_token_group_quant_8bit_v2 (float32 scale storage, ue8m0 rounding) and is
+bitwise identical to it.
+"""
+

+
+import torch
+import triton
+import triton.language as tl
+
+from sglang.kernels.jit.utils import is_arch_support_pdl
+
+# DeepGEMM's TMA needs 16-byte aligned scale columns: 4 fp32 rows.
+_TMA_ALIGN_ROWS = 4
+
+
+@triton.jit
+def _block32_act_quant_ue8m0_kernel(
+    X,
+    Q,
+    S,
+    M,
+    NUM_GROUPS,
+    stride_xm,
+    stride_qm,
+    stride_sg,
+    BLOCK_M: tl.constexpr,
+    BLOCK_G: tl.constexpr,
+    USE_PDL: tl.constexpr,
+):
+    rows = tl.program_id(0) * BLOCK_M + tl.arange(0, BLOCK_M)
+    groups = tl.program_id(1) * BLOCK_G + tl.arange(0, BLOCK_G)
+    cols = groups[None, :, None] * 32 + tl.arange(0, 32)[None, None, :]
+    mask = (rows < M)[:, None] & (groups < NUM_GROUPS)[None, :]
+
+    if USE_PDL:
+        tl.extra.cuda.gdc_wait()
+    x = tl.load(
+        X + rows[:, None, None] * stride_xm + cols, mask=mask[:, :, None], other=0.0
+    ).to(tl.float32)
+    if USE_PDL:
+        tl.extra.cuda.gdc_launch_dependents()
+    # Same steps as the v2 CUDA kernel: amax floor 1e-10, e = log2_ceil(amax / 448)
+    # from the fp32 bits, multiply by 2^-e, clamp, satfinite e4m3; store 2^e.
+    amax = tl.maximum(tl.max(tl.abs(x), axis=2), 1e-10)
+    bits = (amax * (1.0 / 448.0)).to(tl.int32, bitcast=True)

+    scale = ((127 - e) << 23).to(tl.float32, bitcast=True)
+    scale_inv = ((e + 127) << 23).to(tl.float32, bitcast=True)
+    q = tl.minimum(tl.maximum(x * scale[:, :, None], -448.0), 448.0)

+    tl.store(

+        q.to(tl.float8e4nv),
+        mask=mask[:, :, None],
+    )
+    tl.store(S + rows[:, None] + groups[None, :] * stride_sg, scale_inv, mask=mask)

+"""Preprocess-only multimodal metadata served by the EPD encoder.
+
+A decode worker in EPD never embeds multimodal tokens; it only needs the
+expanded input_ids and M-RoPE positions, which follow from the processor
+grids. `/preprocess_meta` runs the CPU preprocessing (no encoder forward) and
+returns per-part grids, token counts, item hashes and video/image aux data in
+the same shape the embedding path carries, so the receiver rebuilds
+`mm_inputs` through the same `get_mm_data` call with no embedding attached.
+"""
+
+import asyncio
+import hashlib
+import json
+import logging
+import uuid
+from collections import OrderedDict
+from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional, Sequence, Tuple
+
+import msgspec
+import torch
+
+from sglang.srt.disaggregation.encoder.preprocessor import (
+    EncoderPreprocessor,
+    EncoderPreprocessResult,
+    _build_mm_aux_data,
+)
+from sglang.srt.managers.schedule_batch import Modality
+from sglang.srt.multimodal.cache import parse_content_hash, snapshot_media
+
+logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)
+
+# Aux attrs that carry one entry per grid and can be sliced per media item.
+# Anything else present (MiMo audio-in-video fields) bypasses the cache.
+_PER_GRID_AUX_ATTRS = ("video_timestamps", "second_per_grid_ts", "original_image_sizes")
+
+
+class MMItemMeta(msgspec.Struct, frozen=True, kw_only=True):
+    """Preprocess result of one media item (possibly several grids)."""
+
+    grid_thw: List[List[int]]
+    token_counts: List[int]
+    hashes: List[int]
+    aux: Dict[str, list]
+
+
+class MMMetaCache:
+    """LRU of MMItemMeta keyed by media identity; single event loop, no lock."""
+
+    def __init__(self, capacity: int):
+        self.capacity = max(0, int(capacity))
+        self._entries: OrderedDict[str, MMItemMeta] = OrderedDict()
+
+    def __len__(self) -> int:
+        return len(self._entries)
+
+    def get(self, key: str) -> Optional[MMItemMeta]:
+        meta = self._entries.get(key)
+        if meta is not None:
+            self._entries.move_to_end(key)
+        return meta
+
+    def put(self, key: str, meta: MMItemMeta) -> None:
+        if self.capacity == 0:
+            return
+        self._entries[key] = meta
+        self._entries.move_to_end(key)
+        while len(self._entries) > self.capacity:
+            self._entries.popitem(last=False)
+
+
+def _media_url(mm_item: Any) -> Any:
+    return mm_item.get("url") if isinstance(mm_item, dict) else mm_item
+
+
+def _inline_payload(url: Any) -> Optional[bytes]:
+    """The bytes of media carried inline, or None for a reference (http, file,
+    path) whose content can change behind the same string."""
+    if isinstance(url, (bytes, bytearray)):
+        return bytes(url)
+    if isinstance(url, str) and url.startswith("data:"):
+        return url.encode("utf-8", "surrogatepass")
+    return None
+
+
+def mm_meta_key(mm_item: Any, modality: Modality) -> Optional[str]:
+    """Content identity of a media item plus every per-item preprocess option:
+    the client's content hash, else a digest of the inline payload. None for a
+    reference without a content hash; such an item is neither cached nor
+    hashed by name."""
+    options: Dict[str, Any] = {}
+    content_hash = None
+    url = _media_url(mm_item)
+    if isinstance(mm_item, dict):
+        content_hash = mm_item.get("content_hash")
+        options = {

+class WaitingListSync:
+    """Collectives over the scheduler ranks that share one waiting list: the
+    TP group without DP attention, one DP shard (attn-TP x attn-CP) with it.
+    No single group spans both shard factors, so each collective runs along
+    every factor in turn; ranks of other DP shards hold other requests."""
+

+        self._groups = [group for group in groups if group.world_size > 1]
+        self.size = math.prod(group.world_size for group in self._groups)

+        for group in self._groups:

+            )

+"""Bounded, request-scoped image snapshots shared by /encode and /preprocess_meta.
+
+This is not a URL cache: the scope identifies one PD bootstrap attempt. Keep
+compressed immutable bytes only, never decoded images or GPU tensors. The cache
+belongs to one EncoderPreprocessor and is accessed by its I/O executor threads.

+import threading
+import time
+from collections import OrderedDict
+from concurrent.futures import Future
+from typing import Any, Callable

+import msgspec

+class _Entry(msgspec.Struct):
+    # concurrent.futures.Future of the snapshot; waiters of the same key join it.
+    future: Any
+    expires_at: float = float("inf")
+    size: int = 0
+
+
+class RequestImageCache:
+    def __init__(self, max_bytes: int, *, ttl: float = 60.0, capacity: int = 4096):
+        self.max_bytes = max(0, max_bytes)
+        self.ttl = ttl
+        self.capacity = capacity
+        self._entries = OrderedDict()
+        self._bytes = 0
+        self._lock = threading.Lock()
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def eligible(scope, url) -> bool:
+        return (
+            isinstance(scope, str)
+            and len(scope) == 64
+            and all(c in "0123456789abcdef" for c in scope)
+            and isinstance(url, str)
+            and url.startswith(("http://", "https://"))
+        )
+
+    def _remove(self, key):
+        entry = self._entries.pop(key)
+        self._bytes -= entry.size
+
+    def _prune(self, now):
+        for key, entry in list(self._entries.items()):
+            if entry.expires_at <= now:
+                self._remove(key)
+        # Do not evict in-flight owners: their other PD consumer must join
+        # the same download, not start another one while this one is active.
+        for key, entry in list(self._entries.items()):
+            if self._bytes <= self.max_bytes:
+                break
+            if entry.expires_at != float("inf"):
+                self._remove(key)
+
+    def get(self, scope, url, loader: Callable[[str], MediaSnapshot]) -> MediaSnapshot:
+        if not self.max_bytes or self.ttl <= 0 or not self.eligible(scope, url):
+            return loader(url)
+        key = (scope, hashlib.sha256(url.encode("utf-8", "surrogatepass")).digest())
+        owner = False
+        with self._lock:
+            self._prune(time.monotonic())
+            entry = self._entries.get(key)
+            if entry is not None:
+                self._entries.move_to_end(key)
+            else:
+                # Bound key/Future storage as well as payload bytes. At capacity
+                # prefer evicting completed entries; otherwise bypass retention.
+                if len(self._entries) >= self.capacity:
+                    for old_key, old in list(self._entries.items()):
+                        if old.expires_at != float("inf"):
+                            self._remove(old_key)
+                            break
+                if len(self._entries) < self.capacity:
+                    entry = _Entry(Future())
+                    self._entries[key] = entry
+                    owner = True
+        if entry is None:
+            return loader(url)
+        if not owner:
+            return entry.future.result()
+        try:
+            snapshot = loader(url)
+        except BaseException as exc:
+            with self._lock:
+                self._remove(key)
+            entry.future.set_exception(exc)
+            raise
+        with self._lock:
+            # Only immutable raw bytes are retained. An oversized image still
+            # serves existing waiters, but cannot exceed the retained-byte cap.
+            size = len(snapshot.data) if isinstance(snapshot.data, bytes) else 0

+                entry.expires_at = time.monotonic() + self.ttl
+                self._bytes += size
+                self._prune(time.monotonic())
+            else:
+                self._remove(key)
+        entry.future.set_result(snapshot)
+        return snapshot

+"""Head <-> row all-to-all of decode attention over NVLink symmetric memory.
+
+Under the DSV4.1 head<->row exchange every TP rank holds ``[rows, H, D]``
+(its ``H`` heads of every row) and the attention wants ``[chunk, W * H, D]``
+(``chunk = ceil(rows / W)`` rows with all ``W * H`` heads), and back. Instead
+of the NCCL all-to-all plus a permute on each side, one push kernel per
+direction stores every segment straight into the receiver's symmetric buffer
+at its final layout. Results are views of that buffer: each stays valid until
+the next exchange on the same instance, so its consumers must run on the
+calling stream before that exchange (the attention reads q, the output
+projection reads o). Bytes are moved unmodified, so outputs are bitwise those
+of the NCCL path, zero row padding included.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import logging
+from typing import Optional
+
+import torch
+import torch.distributed as dist
+
+from sglang.kernels.ops.communication.all_reduce import Communicator, PullPlane
+from sglang.kernels.ops.communication.segment_a2a import segment_a2a
+from sglang.srt.distributed.device_communicators.custom_all_reduce_v2 import (
+    CustomAllReduceV2,
+    _allocate_symmetric_memory,
+)
+from sglang.srt.runtime_context import get_resources
+
+logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)
+
+_SEMAPHORE_BYTES = 128  # sizeof(device::distributed::Semaphore)
+_ALIGN_BYTES = 1024
+# Measured on H20-3e TP4 (3-6 MB per rank): within 5% of the best over 16-128
+# blocks x 256-1024 threads x unroll 2-8. Fixed, as every rank must launch the same grid.
+_NUM_BLOCKS = 64
+_NUM_THREADS = 512
+_UNROLL = 4
+# Semaphore slots: the cap on any launch's grid.
+_MAX_BLOCKS = 128
+# Fallback row capacity when the scheduler config is not published (offline use).
+_DEFAULT_CAPACITY_ROWS = 1024
+_MAX_CAPACITY_BYTES = 64 << 20
+
+
+class SymmHeadA2A:
+    """The two directions of the exchange on one TP group (rank order = head order)."""
+
+    def __init__(self, *, group, capacity_bytes: int) -> None:
+        cpu_group = group.cpu_group
+        self.world_size = int(group.world_size)
+        self.rank = int(group.rank_in_group)
+        assert dist.get_rank(group=cpu_group) == self.rank
+        device = torch.device("cuda", torch.cuda.current_device())
+        self.capacity_bytes = -(-capacity_bytes // _ALIGN_BYTES) * _ALIGN_BYTES
+        sem_bytes = _MAX_BLOCKS * _SEMAPHORE_BYTES
+        total = self.capacity_bytes + sem_bytes
+        self._symm_tensor, symm_mem = _allocate_symmetric_memory(
+            total, device=device, group=cpu_group
+        )
+        slabs = [
+            symm_mem.get_buffer(i, [total], torch.uint8) for i in range(self.world_size)
+        ]
+        # The semaphores must start zeroed on every rank before any peer signals.
+        slabs[self.rank].zero_()
+        torch.cuda.synchronize()
+        dist.barrier(group=cpu_group)
+        self._buffer = slabs[self.rank][: self.capacity_bytes]
+        self.comm = Communicator(
+            pull=PullPlane(
+                self.rank,
+                self.world_size,
+                workspaces=[slab[: self.capacity_bytes] for slab in slabs],
+                semaphores=[
+                    slab[self.capacity_bytes :].view(_MAX_BLOCKS, _SEMAPHORE_BYTES)
+                    for slab in slabs
+                ],
+            )
+        )
+        if self.rank == 0:
+            logger.info(
+                "Symmetric-memory head<->row a2a: %.2f MB receive buffer, world %d",
+                self.capacity_bytes / (1 << 20),
+                self.world_size,
+            )

+"""DeepSeek-V4.1 decode attention on SM90 (dsv41_sm90 "decode").
+
+The H20 tile schedule for FlashMLA's legacy sparse decode, and the DSpark draft
+rows of a request packed into one FlashMLA row. Neither is bitwise to the stock
+path: another split-KV partition changes the combine, by at most one bf16 ulp of
+a row's largest output on H20, with the same error against an fp64 reference.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import functools
+from typing import Callable, Optional
+
+import msgspec
+import torch
+
+# The JIT scheduler stages its schedules in 48 KB of shared memory.
+_SCHED_MAX_BATCH = 1024
+# Devices the scheduler's cost model was fitted on (one 78-SM die); others keep
+# FlashMLA's own schedule.
+_SCHED_DEVICES = ("NVIDIA H20", "NVIDIA H20-3e")
+# FlashMLA's SM90 sparse decode takes these head counts only.
+_DECODE_HEADS = (64, 128)
+
+
+@functools.lru_cache(maxsize=None)
+def _num_sms(device_index: int) -> int:
+    return torch.cuda.get_device_properties(device_index).multi_processor_count
+
+
+def flashmla_sched_tuned(device: torch.device) -> bool:
+    return torch.cuda.get_device_name(device) in _SCHED_DEVICES
+
+
+def fill_flashmla_sched_meta(
+    flashmla_metadata,
+    *,
+    q: torch.Tensor,
+    indices: torch.Tensor,
+    topk_length: Optional[torch.Tensor],
+    extra_indices: Optional[torch.Tensor],
+    extra_topk_length: Optional[torch.Tensor],
+) -> None:
+    """Hand an unscheduled FlashMLASchedMeta the H20 cost-model schedule, so the
+    legacy decode skips its own get_mla_metadata_kernel; other shapes keep it."""
+    if (
+        flashmla_metadata is None
+        or flashmla_metadata.tile_scheduler_metadata is not None
+        or topk_length is None
+    ):
+        return
+    b, s_q, h_q = q.shape[0], q.shape[1], q.shape[2]
+    if s_q != 1 or h_q not in _DECODE_HEADS or b > _SCHED_MAX_BATCH:
+        return
+    from sglang.kernels.ops.attention.dsv4.flashmla_sparse_sched import (
+        flashmla_sparse_sched_meta,
+    )
+
+    # Legacy Decode_Sm90_Impl::get_meta: num_sm_parts = num_sms / s_q / (h_q / 64).
+    num_sm_parts = max(_num_sms(q.device.index) // (h_q // 64), 1)
+    meta, num_splits = flashmla_sparse_sched_meta(
+        topk_length=topk_length,
+        extra_topk_length=extra_topk_length,
+        topk=indices.shape[-1],
