+"""FP8 LM head (DeepSeek-V4.1 ``lm_head``): a row's logits must not depend on how
+the batch is split into DeepGEMM launches or on the swap-AB kernel taking the
+batch instead, the load-time quantization must stay within e4m3 rounding of the
+bf16 head across its staging steps and padded vocab tail, and re-quantization
+must keep the buffers CUDA graphs captured."""
+
+import unittest
+
+import torch
+
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_cuda_ci
+from sglang.test.test_utils import CustomTestCase
+
+register_cuda_ci(est_time=60, stage="base-b-kernel-unit", runner_config="1-gpu-large")
+
+# Large enough to take the 128 + tail split; not a multiple of 128 (padded tail block)
+# and spanning several 8192-row quantization steps.
+_N = 65600
+_K = 512
+
+
+def _head(weight, *, use_swapab=False):
+    from sglang.srt.layers.quantization.fp8_lm_head import (
+        Fp8LmHead,
+        fp8_lm_head_supported,
+    )
+
+    if not fp8_lm_head_supported():
+        raise unittest.SkipTest("needs SM90 DeepGEMM with fp32 scales")
+    return Fp8LmHead(weight, use_swapab=use_swapab)
+
+
+@unittest.skipUnless(
+    torch.cuda.is_available() and torch.cuda.get_device_capability()[0] == 9,
+    "SM90 DeepGEMM",
+)
+class TestFp8LmHead(CustomTestCase):
+    def setUp(self):
+        torch.manual_seed(0)
+        # Row norms spread over 2^-4..2^4 so a misplaced block scale shows up.
+        row_scale = torch.exp2(torch.empty(_N, 1).uniform_(-4, 4))
+        self.weight = (torch.randn(_N, _K) * row_scale).to(torch.bfloat16).cuda()
+
+    def test_split_launches_match_single_row_launches(self):
+        from sglang.srt.layers.quantization.fp8_lm_head import split_rows
+
+        head = _head(self.weight)
+        self.assertEqual(split_rows(192, head.weight.shape[0]), [(0, 128), (128, 192)])
+        x = torch.randn(192, _K, device="cuda").to(torch.bfloat16)
+        batched = head(x)
+        self.assertEqual(tuple(batched.shape), (192, _N))
+        for row in (0, 77, 127, 128, 160, 191):
+            with self.subTest(row=row):
+                single = head(x[row : row + 1])
+                torch.testing.assert_close(
+                    batched[row : row + 1], single, rtol=0, atol=0
+                )
+
+    def test_swapab_launch_is_bitwise_the_deepgemm_path(self):
+        from sglang.srt.layers.quantization.fp8_lm_head import swapab_tile
+
+        deepgemm = _head(self.weight)
+        swapab = _head(self.weight, use_swapab=True)
+        # Every tile family (one piece, 32/64/128 + tail), padded and exact tiles.
+        for m in (1, 12, 20, 36, 48, 70, 80, 96, 132, 150, 160):
+            with self.subTest(m=m):
+                self.assertIsNotNone(swapab_tile(m))
+                x = torch.randn(m, _K, device="cuda").to(torch.bfloat16)
+                torch.testing.assert_close(swapab(x), deepgemm(x), rtol=0, atol=0)
+
+    def test_quantization_error_is_e4m3_rounding(self):
+        head = _head(self.weight)
+        x = torch.randn(48, _K, device="cuda").to(torch.bfloat16)
+        got = head(x).float()
+        ref = x.float() @ self.weight.float().T
+        # e4m3 rounding of both operands gives ~3% per vocab row; a misplaced block
+        # scale (8192-row step edges, padded tail block) gives O(1).
+        rel = (got - ref).norm(dim=0) / ref.norm(dim=0)
+        self.assertLess(rel.max().item(), 0.1)
+
+    def test_requantize_keeps_buffers_and_empty_batch(self):
+        head = _head(self.weight)
+        ptrs = (head.weight.data_ptr(), head.weight_scale.data_ptr())
+        x = torch.randn(8, _K, device="cuda").to(torch.bfloat16)
+        before = head(x)
+        head.requantize_(-self.weight)
+        self.assertEqual((head.weight.data_ptr(), head.weight_scale.data_ptr()), ptrs)
+        torch.testing.assert_close(head(x), -before, rtol=0, atol=0)
+        # DP-attention idle ranks run the LM head on zero rows.
+        empty = head(torch.empty(0, _K, device="cuda", dtype=torch.bfloat16))
+        self.assertEqual(tuple(empty.shape), (0, _N))
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()

+    comb = (comb / comb.sum(-1, keepdim=True)).contiguous()

+def _qdq_special_blocks(x):
+    """Zero and tiny blocks (the 1e-4 amax floor), exact scale boundaries and
+    adjacent bf16 values catch floor, scale-rounding and FP8 tie errors."""
+    flat = x.view(-1, 32)
+    flat[:3] *= 1e-7
+    flat[3] = 0
+    up = torch.tensor(float("inf"), device=x.device, dtype=x.dtype)
+    for i, v in enumerate((0.875, 1.75, 3.5, 7.0)):
+        flat[4 + i] = v
+        flat[4 + i, 0] = torch.nextafter(flat[4 + i, 0], up)
+    return x

+                    torch.testing.assert_close(

+"""CP decode attention TP: every weight-derived tensor a sliced linear's GEMM reads
+must describe the same slice as its weight."""
+
+import unittest
+from unittest.mock import patch
+
+import torch
+
+from sglang.srt.layers.cp.cp_decode_attn_tp import CpDecodeAttnTpContext
+from sglang.srt.layers.linear import ColumnParallelLinear, RowParallelLinear
+from sglang.srt.layers.quantization.fp8_utils import (
+    block_quant_dequant,
+    triton_w8a8_block_fp8_linear,
+)
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_cuda_ci
+from sglang.test.test_utils import CustomTestCase
+
+register_cuda_ci(est_time=10, stage="base-b", runner_config="1-gpu-small")
+
+BLOCK = [32, 32]
+
+
+def _block32_linear(cls, n, k, gen):
+    """A block32 ue8m0 FP8 linear carrying the Hopper BF16 weight cache, as
+    Fp8LinearMethod.process_weights_after_loading_block_quant leaves it."""
+    linear = cls.__new__(cls)
+    torch.nn.Module.__init__(linear)
+    weight = (torch.randn(n, k, device="cuda", generator=gen) * 64).to(
+        torch.float8_e4m3fn
+    )
+    exponents = torch.randint(-10, -4, (n // 32, k // 32), device="cuda", generator=gen)
+    scale = torch.pow(2.0, exponents.float())
+    linear.weight = torch.nn.Parameter(weight, requires_grad=False)
+    linear.weight_scale_inv = torch.nn.Parameter(scale, requires_grad=False)
+    linear.register_buffer(
+        "_block_fp8_bf16_weight",
+        block_quant_dequant(weight, scale, BLOCK, torch.bfloat16),
+        persistent=False,
+    )
+    linear.input_size_per_partition = k
+    linear.output_size_per_partition = n
+    linear.use_decode_attn_tp = False
+    return linear
+
+
+@unittest.skipUnless(torch.cuda.is_available(), "Triton block32 FP8 GEMM")
+class TestCpDecodeAttnTpBf16WeightCache(CustomTestCase):
+    def test_large_batch_gemm_reads_the_sliced_weight(self):
+        """With a [32, 32] block-FP8 weight the SM90 linear runs batches of 64+ rows
+        on a BF16 copy of the weight; under CP decode attention TP that copy must
+        be sliced like the FP8 weight, or the GEMM reads the full weight."""
+        tp_size, rank, n, k, rows = 4, 1, 256, 512, 64
+        gen = torch.Generator(device="cuda").manual_seed(0)
+        ctx = CpDecodeAttnTpContext.__new__(CpDecodeAttnTpContext)
+        ctx.decode_tp_rank, ctx.decode_tp_size = rank, tp_size
+        ctx.use_decode_attn_tp = False
+        ctx._slice_cache = {}
+
+        def decode(_forward_batch):
+            ctx.use_decode_attn_tp = True
+
+        for cls, in_features in (
+            (ColumnParallelLinear, k),
+            (RowParallelLinear, k // tp_size),
+        ):
+            with self.subTest(cls=cls.__name__):
+                linear = _block32_linear(cls, n, k, gen)
+                full_cache = linear._block_fp8_bf16_weight
+                x = torch.randn(rows, in_features, device="cuda", generator=gen)
+                x = x.bfloat16()
+                with (
+                    patch.object(ctx, "set_decode_attn_tp", side_effect=decode),
+                    ctx.maybe_use_decode_attn_tp(None, [linear]),
+                ):
+                    args = dict(
+                        input=x,
+                        weight=linear.weight,
+                        block_size=BLOCK,
+                        weight_scale=linear.weight_scale_inv,
+                        act_scale_ue8m0=True,
+                    )
+                    fp8 = triton_w8a8_block_fp8_linear(**args)
+                    cached = triton_w8a8_block_fp8_linear(
+                        **args, weight_bf16=linear._block_fp8_bf16_weight
+                    )
+                torch.testing.assert_close(cached, fp8, rtol=2e-2, atol=1e-1)
+                self.assertIs(linear._block_fp8_bf16_weight, full_cache)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()

+class _StagedEncoder:
+    """batch_encode that preprocesses, then runs a gated forward under compute_lock."""

+    async def batch_encode(self, requests, _modality, compute_lock=None):

+            self.events.append(("forward", req_id))
+            self.forward_started.set()
+            await self.finish_forward.wait()
+            self.events.append(("forward_done", req_id))

+With --tokenizer-worker-num 4 on P and 8 on D in a 2E3P1D setup on H20,

+the others log "address already in use", and encoders register with one worker.

+        thread.start()
+        router.encoder_bootstrap_server = _registry(

+        )
+        registry = router.encoder_bootstrap_server

+        receivers, workers = [], []
+        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
+            try:
+
+                def join(index):
+                    ipc = f"ipc://{tmp}/worker-{index}"
+                    recv = context.socket(zmq.PULL)
+                    recv.setsockopt(zmq.RCVTIMEO, 2000)
+                    recv.bind(ipc)
+                    receivers.append(recv)

+"""A fake PD handoff (health check, warmup) must not consume a previous
+request's metadata slot: no prefill writes it, and a recycled slot still holds
+the last owner's cache stats, logprobs, spec hidden states and DSA top-k
+positions, which can point past the fake request's own KV."""
+
+import unittest
+from types import SimpleNamespace
+from unittest.mock import Mock
+
+import torch
+
+from sglang.srt.disaggregation.decode import DecodeTransferQueue
+from sglang.srt.disaggregation.utils import FAKE_BOOTSTRAP_HOST, MetadataBuffers
+from sglang.srt.environ import envs
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_cpu_ci
+from sglang.test.test_utils import CustomTestCase
+
+register_cpu_ci(est_time=2, suite="base-a-test-cpu")
+
+
+def _buffers():
+    with envs.SGLANG_ENABLE_DISAGG_SAMPLING_MASK.override(True):
+        return MetadataBuffers(
+            size=2,
+            hidden_size=4,
+            hidden_states_dtype=torch.float32,
+            max_sampling_mask_tokens=4,
+            max_top_logprobs_num=2,
+            output_dsa_topk_indices_dim=3,
+        )
+
+
+def _dirty(buffers, cached_tokens):
+    """What a released real transfer leaves behind: every field written, only
+    the readiness marker cleared (MetadataBuffers.clear_slot)."""
+    for buf in vars(buffers).values():
+        if isinstance(buf, torch.Tensor):
+            buf.fill_(2)
+    buffers.cached_tokens[0, 0] = cached_tokens
+    buffers.clear_slot(0)
+
+
+def _decode_request(*, fake: bool):
+    return SimpleNamespace(
+        metadata_buffer_index=0,
+        is_rebootstrap=False,
+        kv_receiver=SimpleNamespace(clear=Mock()),
+        req=SimpleNamespace(
+            rid="HEALTH_CHECK_reused_slot" if fake else "real_pd_request",
+            bootstrap_host=FAKE_BOOTSTRAP_HOST if fake else "10.0.0.1",
+            bootstrap_room=0 if fake else 2,
+            vocab_size=32000,
+            output_ids=[],
+            return_logprob=True,
+            return_sampling_mask=False,
+            logprob=SimpleNamespace(
+                top_logprobs_num=2,
+                token_ids_logprob=None,
+                output_token_logprobs_val=[],
+                output_token_logprobs_idx=[],
+                output_top_logprobs_val=[],
+                output_top_logprobs_idx=[],
+            ),
+            time_stats=SimpleNamespace(set_wait_queue_entry_time=Mock()),
+        ),
+    )
+
+
+def _queue(buffers):
+    queue = DecodeTransferQueue.__new__(DecodeTransferQueue)
+    queue.metadata_buffers = buffers
+    queue.scheduler = SimpleNamespace(
+        kv_checksum_computer=None,
+        batch_result_processor=SimpleNamespace(_maybe_update_reasoning_tokens=Mock()),
+    )
+    queue.spec_algorithm = SimpleNamespace(is_none=lambda: False)
+    queue._commit_hicache_local_restore_to_req = Mock()
+    return queue
+
+
+class TestFakePDMetadata(CustomTestCase):
+    def test_reused_slot_gives_a_fake_request_none_of_the_old_owner(self):
+        buffers = _buffers()
+        _dirty(buffers, cached_tokens=281984)
+        other_slot = buffers.get_buf(1)
+        request = _decode_request(fake=True)
+
+        _queue(buffers)._commit_transfer_to_req(request)
+
+        req = request.req
+        self.assertEqual(req.cached_tokens, 0)
+        self.assertEqual(req.already_computed, 0)
+        self.assertEqual(req.cached_tokens_device, 0)
+        # Stale top-k positions would index past this request's KV.
+        self.assertIsNone(req.output_dsa_topk_indices)
+        for tensor in (
+            req.output_topk_p,
+            req.output_topk_index,
+            req.hidden_states_tensor,
+        ):
+            self.assertEqual(torch.count_nonzero(tensor).item(), 0)
+        self.assertEqual(req.logprob.output_token_logprobs_val, [0.0])
+        self.assertEqual(req.logprob.output_top_logprobs_idx, [[0, 0]])
+        self.assertEqual(len(req.output_ids), 1)
+        self.assertIsNone(request.kv_receiver)
+        # Only the fake request's slot is reset.
+        for before, after in zip(other_slot, buffers.get_buf(1)):
+            torch.testing.assert_close(before, after)
+
+    def test_real_transfer_still_reads_what_prefill_wrote(self):
+        buffers = _buffers()
+        _dirty(buffers, cached_tokens=1024)
+        buffers.bootstrap_room[0, 0] = 2  # prefill published the slot
+        request = _decode_request(fake=False)
+
+        _queue(buffers)._commit_transfer_to_req(request)
+
+        self.assertEqual(request.req.cached_tokens, 1024)
+        self.assertEqual(request.req.output_ids, [2])
+        self.assertEqual(request.req.output_dsa_topk_indices.tolist(), [2, 2, 2])
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()

+"""A PD prefill that retires a request before the KV handoff must fail the
+room on decode at once, with the prefill's reason.
+
+Otherwise decode never hears about a request that prefill aborted before
+creating its KV sender (an EPD encoder failure, an intake reject, a KV capacity
+reject): it waits for KV until SGLANG_DISAGGREGATION_WAITING_TIMEOUT and the
+client gets an error ~300 s later. Decode can register its destination before
+or after prefill gives up, so both orders are covered.
+"""
+
+import threading
+import time
+import unittest
+from collections import OrderedDict, defaultdict
+from http import HTTPStatus
+from types import SimpleNamespace
+from unittest.mock import MagicMock, patch
+
+import numpy as np
+
+from sglang.srt.disaggregation.base.conn import KVPoll
+from sglang.srt.disaggregation.common.conn import KVTransferError
+from sglang.srt.disaggregation.common.utils import pack_int_lists
+from sglang.srt.disaggregation.mooncake.conn import (
+    MooncakeKVManager,
+    MooncakeKVReceiver,
+    MooncakeKVSender,
+)
+from sglang.srt.disaggregation.nixl.conn import GUARD as NIXL_GUARD
+from sglang.srt.disaggregation.nixl.conn import NixlKVManager
+from sglang.srt.disaggregation.prefill import PrefillBootstrapQueue
+from sglang.srt.disaggregation.utils import FAKE_BOOTSTRAP_HOST
+from sglang.srt.managers.scheduler_components.request_receiver import (
+    SchedulerRequestReceiver,
+)
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_cpu_ci
+from sglang.test.test_utils import CustomTestCase
+
+register_cpu_ci(est_time=3, suite="base-a-test-cpu")
+
+ROOM = 6359277859203974196
+REASON = "Timeout waiting for image embedding after 180.0s"
+DECODE_IP, DECODE_PORT = "10.0.0.2", 23456
+DECODE_TCP = f"tcp://{DECODE_IP}:{DECODE_PORT}"
+
+
+class _StopLoop(Exception):
+    pass
+
+
+def _prefill_manager(bootstrap_timeout=300, manager_cls=MooncakeKVManager):
+    mgr = object.__new__(manager_cls)
+    mgr.request_status = {}
+    mgr.transfer_infos = {}
+    mgr.req_to_decode_prefix_len = {}
+    mgr._failed_room_tombstones = OrderedDict()
+    mgr.bootstrap_timeout = bootstrap_timeout
+    mgr.failure_records = {}
+    mgr.failure_lock = threading.Lock()
+    mgr.is_mla_backend = False
+    mgr.enable_deferred_decode_kv_release = True
+    mgr.enable_staging = False
+    mgr._staging_outstanding = defaultdict(int)
+    mgr._deferred_ack_targets = {}
+    mgr._deferred_ack_poisoned_rooms = set()
+    mgr.attn_tp_rank = mgr.attn_cp_rank = mgr.pp_rank = 0
+    mgr.attn_cp_size = mgr.pp_size = 1
+    mgr.server_args = SimpleNamespace(enable_pd_role_switch=False)
+    mgr._stopped = False
+    mgr._worker_threads = []
+    mgr.sent = []
+    mgr._send_multipart_locked = lambda endpoint, parts, is_ipv6=False: mgr.sent.append(
+        (endpoint, parts)
+    )
+    return mgr
+
+
+def _registration(room=ROOM):
+    """What decode's MooncakeKVManager.build_receiver_metadata_message sends."""
+    return [
+        str(room).encode("ascii"),
+        DECODE_IP.encode("ascii"),
+        str(DECODE_PORT).encode("ascii"),
+        b"decode-session",
+        np.array([3, 4], dtype=np.int32).tobytes(),
+        b"0",
+        pack_int_lists([], "i"),
+        b"1",
+        b"0",
+        b"",
+    ]
+
+
+def _abort(room=ROOM, generation=b"7"):
+    return [
+        b"ABORT",
+        str(room).encode("ascii"),
+        DECODE_IP.encode("ascii"),
+        str(DECODE_PORT).encode("ascii"),
+        generation,
+    ]
+
+
+def _run_mooncake_prefill_thread(mgr, messages):
+    """Run the mooncake prefill control loop over ``messages`` on this thread."""
+    mgr.server_socket = MagicMock()
+    mgr.server_socket.recv_multipart.side_effect = [*messages, _StopLoop()]
+    with patch("sglang.srt.disaggregation.mooncake.conn.threading.Thread") as thread:
+        mgr.start_prefill_thread()
+    try:
+        thread.call_args.kwargs["target"]()
+    except _StopLoop:
+        pass
+
+
+def _run_mooncake_decode_thread(mgr, messages):
+    """Run the mooncake decode control loop over ``messages`` on this thread."""
+    mgr.server_args = SimpleNamespace(enable_pd_role_switch=False)
+    mgr._stopped = False
+    mgr._worker_threads = []
+    mgr._start_heartbeat_checker_thread = MagicMock()
+    mgr.server_socket = MagicMock()
+    mgr.server_socket.recv_multipart.side_effect = [*messages, _StopLoop()]
+    with patch("sglang.srt.disaggregation.mooncake.conn.threading.Thread") as thread:
+        mgr.start_decode_thread()
+    try:
+        thread.call_args.kwargs["target"]()
+    except _StopLoop:
+        pass
+
+
+def _nixl_registration(room=ROOM, agent=b"decode-agent", required=b"1"):
+    """What decode's NIXL receiver sends a prefill rank for one room."""
+    return [
+        NIXL_GUARD,
+        str(room).encode("ascii"),
+        DECODE_IP.encode("ascii"),
+        str(DECODE_PORT).encode("ascii"),
+        agent,
+        np.array([3, 4], dtype=np.int32).tobytes(),
+        b"0",
+        required,
+    ]
+
+
+def _run_nixl_prefill_thread(mgr, messages):
+    # Read by the thread's crash log, which the end-of-input sentinel triggers.
+    mgr.kv_args = SimpleNamespace(engine_rank=0)
+    mgr.server_socket = MagicMock()
+    mgr.server_socket.recv_multipart.side_effect = [*messages, _StopLoop()]
+    with patch("sglang.srt.disaggregation.nixl.conn.threading.Thread") as thread:
+        mgr._start_bootstrap_thread()
+    try:
+        thread.call_args.kwargs["target"]()
+    except _StopLoop:
+        pass

+def _lowest_position_topk(scores, k):
+    """Positions of the k largest finite scores, ties to the lowest position."""
+    order = torch.argsort(scores.cpu(), descending=True, stable=True)
+    picked = order[:k]
+    picked = picked[scores.cpu()[picked] > -torch.inf]
+    return sorted(picked.tolist())

+    values = raw_row.tolist()
+    kept = [v for v in values if v >= 0]
+    # Sorted ascending, every hole after the picks.
+    assert values == kept + [-1] * (len(values) - len(kept))
+    return kept

+            return _lowest_position_topk(scores.masked_fill(~keep, -torch.inf), TOPK)
+

+        backend.consume_prefill(consumer, published)
+        self._check_rows(batch, consumer, among_blocks)
+
+
+DECODE_TOPK = 64
+DECODE_BLOCKS = 8  # compact from 16 windows of 8 blocks of 8: lmax >= 1024
+
+
+class _DecodeBatch:
+    """Requests (five by default) at graph capacity ``lmax`` compressed positions,
+    ``group`` rows each (DSpark verify, or 1 for decode). With most keys zero,
+    exact 0.0 ties fill the last slots of the longer rows; block scales within
+    2^5 keep every fp32 partial dot exact, which the wgmma kernels need."""
+
+    def __init__(self, *, ratio, lmax, group, seed=0, zero_keys=0.97, context=None):
+        g = torch.Generator(device="cuda").manual_seed(seed)
+        self.ratio, self.lmax, self.group = ratio, lmax, group
+        num_reqs = 5 if context is None else len(context)
+        num_slots = num_reqs * lmax
+        self.table = torch.randint(
+            0,
+            256,
+            (num_slots // PAGE, PAGE * 68),
+            dtype=torch.uint8,
+            device="cuda",
+            generator=g,
+        )
+        self.table[:, PAGE * 64 :] = torch.randint(
+            124,
+            129,
+            (num_slots // PAGE, PAGE * 4),
+            dtype=torch.uint8,
+            device="cuda",
+            generator=g,
+        )
+        payload = self.table[:, : PAGE * 64].view(num_slots // PAGE, PAGE, 64)
+        zero = (
+            torch.rand(num_slots // PAGE, PAGE, device="cuda", generator=g) < zero_keys
+        )
+        payload.masked_fill_(zero[..., None], 0)
+        slots = torch.stack(
+            [
+                torch.randperm(num_slots, device="cuda", generator=g)[:lmax]
+                for _ in range(num_reqs)
+            ]
+        )
+        offsets = torch.arange(ratio, device="cuda")
+        self.req_to_token = (
+            (slots[:, :, None] * ratio + offsets).flatten(1).to(torch.int32)
+        )
+        self.req = torch.arange(num_reqs, device="cuda").repeat_interleave(group)
+        rows = self.req.shape[0]
+        if context is None:
+            context = [
+                0,
+                9,
+                lmax * ratio // 3,
+                lmax * ratio * 2 // 3,
+                lmax * ratio - group,
+            ]
+        num_reqs = len(context)
+        context = torch.tensor(context)
+        positions = context.cuda()[self.req] + torch.arange(
+            group, device="cuda"
+        ).repeat(num_reqs)
+        self.positions = positions.clamp_max(lmax * ratio - 1)
+        self.q = fake_quant_fp4(
+            torch.randn(rows, 32, 128, device="cuda", generator=g)
+        ).bfloat16()
+        self.weights = torch.rand(rows, 32, device="cuda", generator=g).bfloat16()
+
+    def inputs(self, topk=DECODE_TOPK):
+        rows = self.req.shape[0]
+        return DecodeInputs(
+            indexer=_Indexer(topk),
+            layer_id=0,
+            compress_ratio=self.ratio,
+            freqs_cis=torch.zeros(self.lmax * self.ratio, device="cuda"),
+            x=self.weights,
+            q_lora=self.q,
+            positions=self.positions,
+            req_rows=self.req,
+            paged_metadata=SimpleNamespace(
+                max_compressed_seq_len=self.lmax,
+                use_topk_v2=True,
+                rows_per_request=self.group,
+            ),
+            is_verify=self.group > 1,
+            out_page_indices=torch.full(
+                (rows + 3, topk), 5, dtype=torch.int32, device="cuda"
+            ),
+        )
+
+    def logits(self):
+        """The upstream paged scores (the switch-off path) and visible lengths."""
+        lens = ((self.positions + 1) // self.ratio).to(torch.int32)
+        scores = fp4_index_logits_paged(
+            self.q,
+            self.weights,
+            self.req,
+            self.req_to_token,
+            lens,
+            self.table,
+            PAGE,
+            self.lmax,
+            self.ratio,
+        )
+        return scores, lens
+
+    def slots(self, row, positions):
+        columns = torch.tensor(positions, dtype=torch.int64, device="cuda") * self.ratio
+        return (self.req_to_token[self.req[row], columns] // self.ratio).tolist()
+
+
+def _expected_blocks(scores, length):
+    """The source's blocks: top DECODE_BLOCKS block maxima, the newest +inf,
+    ties to the lowest block, as (ascending block ids, positions they hold)."""
+    width = -(-scores.shape[0] // BLOCK) * BLOCK
+    padded = torch.full((width,), -torch.inf, device=scores.device)
+    padded[:length] = scores[:length]
+    maxima = padded.view(-1, BLOCK).amax(-1)
+    if length:
+        maxima[(length - 1) // BLOCK] = torch.inf
+    blocks = _lowest_position_topk(maxima, DECODE_BLOCKS)
+    count = sum(min(BLOCK, max(0, length - b * BLOCK)) for b in blocks)
+    return blocks, count
+

+    def test_compact_source_and_consumer_through_graph_replay(self):

+        published = run()

+        graph = torch.cuda.CUDAGraph()

+"""The row-sliced V4.1 indexer on CPU (deepseek_v4_head_a2a, mix_decode): under
+the SM90 head<->row all-to-all each rank selects the ratio-1/2 index top-k of
+only the rows its attention reads.
+
+The layers of one forward (a full top-k layer, a candidate source and its
+consumer) run through DeepseekV4AttnBackend.forward_low_ratio_sources once for
+the whole batch and once per simulated rank with its row slice. The stand-in
+scores are a function of the row's own inputs, so every rank's rows of the shared
+top-k buffers must equal the same rows of the whole-batch run, and no other row
+may be written."""
+
+import unittest
+from types import SimpleNamespace
+from unittest.mock import patch
+
+import torch
+
+from sglang.srt.layers.attention import deepseek_v4_backend
+from sglang.srt.layers.attention.deepseek_v4_backend import DeepseekV4AttnBackend
+from sglang.srt.layers.attention.dsv4.v41_indexer import dense_blocks, full_topk
+from sglang.srt.layers.attention.dsv4.v41_indexer.dense_blocks import (
+    BlockIds,
+    DenseBlocksBackend,
+)
+from sglang.srt.layers.attention.dsv4.v41_indexer.full_topk import FullTopKIndexer
+from sglang.srt.layers.attention.dsv4.v41_indexer.scoring import DecodeScores
+from sglang.srt.model_executor.forward_batch_info import ForwardMode
+from sglang.srt.models.deepseek_v4_head_a2a import head_a2a_rows
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_cpu_ci
+from sglang.test.test_utils import CustomTestCase
+
+register_cpu_ci(est_time=5, suite="base-a-test-cpu")
+
+TOPK = 8
+LMAX = 48  # compressed positions the decode scores span
+PAGE = 4  # compressed page size of the indexer page table
+UNWRITTEN = 12345
+# (layer id, ratio, candidate source, candidate consumer, has an indexer)
+LAYERS = (
+    (2, 2, False, False, True),
+    (3, 2, False, False, False),  # reads layer 2's top-k
+    (20, 1, True, False, True),
+    (21, 1, False, False, False),
+    (24, 1, False, True, True),
+)
+
+
+def _fake_decode_scores(
+    *, inputs, token_to_kv_pool, req_to_token, candidate_mask=None, **_
+):
+    """Non-paged scores of the rows in ``inputs``, a function of each row's own
+    x, q_lora, request and position, so a mis-sliced input changes them."""
+    req, pos = inputs.req_rows, inputs.positions
+    bs = req.shape[0]
+    inputs.reset_outputs()
+    if bs == 0:
+        return None
+    ratio = inputs.compress_ratio
+    lens = (pos + 1) // ratio
+    j = torch.arange(LMAX)
+    scores = torch.sin(
+        j[None, :] * 0.37
+        + inputs.x[:, :1].double() * 1.7
+        + inputs.q_lora[:, :1].double() * 3.1
+        + req[:, None] * 2.9
+        + pos[:, None] * 1.3
+        + inputs.layer_id * 0.11
+    ).float()
+    scores = scores.masked_fill(j[None, :] >= lens[:, None], -torch.inf)
+    slots = req_to_token[req[:, None], (j * ratio)[None, :]] // ratio
+    slots = slots.masked_fill(j[None, :] >= lens[:, None], 0)
+    return DecodeScores(bs=bs, lmax=LMAX, lens=lens, slots=slots, scores=scores)
+
+
+def _fake_topk_page_transform(
+    scores, topk, *, page_table, page_size, end, sorted_index, output_idx
+):
+    """DeepSelect's contract: top-k columns of each row through its page table."""
+    assert page_table.shape[0] == scores.shape[0] == output_idx.shape[0]
+    output_idx.fill_(-1)
+    for r in range(scores.shape[0]):
+        k = min(topk, int(end[r]))
+        cols = scores[r].topk(k).indices.sort().values
+        output_idx[r, :k] = (
+            page_table[r, cols // page_size] * page_size + cols % page_size
+        )
+    return output_idx
+
+
+class _Case:
+    def __init__(self, mode, num_requests, rows_per_request):
+        torch.manual_seed(num_requests * 10 + rows_per_request)
+        rows = num_requests * rows_per_request
+        self.mode, self.rows = mode, rows
+        request = torch.arange(rows) // rows_per_request
+        self.req = request + 3  # req_to_token rows
+        # Visible lengths from 1 up to under LMAX, some shorter than TOPK.
+        prefix = 2 + 3 * request
+        self.pos = prefix + torch.arange(rows) % rows_per_request
+        self.x = torch.randn(rows, 16)
+        self.q_lora = torch.randn(rows, 8)
+        self.req_to_token = (
+            torch.arange(32)[:, None] * 1000 + torch.arange(2 * LMAX + 2)[None, :]
+        )
+        # Per batch row, distinct across rows: an offset error shows.
+        self.page_table = (
+            torch.arange(rows)[:, None] * 100 + torch.arange(LMAX // PAGE)[None, :]
+        ).int()
+
+    def backend(self, deep_select: bool):
+        backend = object.__new__(DeepseekV4AttnBackend)
+        backend.tail_source_kv_layer_id = None
+        # Target verify is an extend mode; it never runs in the prefill graph.
+        backend._low_ratio_in_prefill_graph = lambda: False
+        full = FullTopKIndexer(
+            token_to_kv_pool=None,
+            req_to_token=self.req_to_token,
+            use_deep_gemm_prefill=False,
+            use_deep_gemm_decode=False,
+        )
+        full.use_deep_select_decode = deep_select
+        backend.full_topk_indexer = full
+        backend.decode_candidates = DenseBlocksBackend(
+            token_to_kv_pool=None,
+            req_to_token=self.req_to_token,
+            candidate_topk_blocks=3,
+            candidate_block_size=8,
+            use_deep_gemm_prefill=False,
+        )
+        buffers = {
+            ratio: torch.full((self.rows, TOPK), UNWRITTEN, dtype=torch.int32)
+            for ratio in (1, 2)
+        }
+        indexer_metadata = SimpleNamespace(
+            max_compressed_seq_len=LMAX,
+            page_table=self.page_table,
+            compressed_page_size=PAGE,
+        )
+        backend.forward_metadata = SimpleNamespace(
+            low_ratio_req_indices=self.req,
+            low_ratio_pos_i64=self.pos,
+            candidate_metadata=None,
+            c1_indexer_metadata=indexer_metadata,
+            c2_indexer_metadata=indexer_metadata,
+            core_metadata=SimpleNamespace(sparse_page_indices=buffers.__getitem__),
+        )
+        backend.compressed_rows = []
+        backend._low_ratio_compress = lambda layer, x, req, pos, fb: (
+            backend.compressed_rows.append((x.shape[0], req.shape[0], pos.shape[0]))
+        )
+        return backend, buffers
+
+    def run(self, deep_select, row_slice=None):
+        """The top-k buffers after each layer, and the backend."""
+        backend, buffers = self.backend(deep_select)
+        forward_batch = SimpleNamespace(
+            forward_mode=self.mode, encoder_swa_replay=False
+        )
+        after = []
+        with (
+            patch.object(deepseek_v4_backend, "dsa_use_prefill_cp", lambda fb: False),
+            patch.object(full_topk, "decode_scores", _fake_decode_scores),
+            patch.object(dense_blocks, "decode_scores", _fake_decode_scores),
+            patch.object(full_topk, "topk_page_transform", _fake_topk_page_transform),
+        ):
+            for layer_id, ratio, source, consumer, has_indexer in LAYERS:
+                layer = SimpleNamespace(
+                    layer_id=layer_id,
+                    compress_ratio=ratio,
+                    freqs_cis=None,
+                    compressor=object(),
+                    indexer=(
+                        SimpleNamespace(
+                            is_candidate_source=source,
+                            uses_candidates=consumer,
+                            index_topk=TOPK,
+                        )
+                        if has_indexer
+                        else None
+                    ),
+                )
+                backend.forward_low_ratio_sources(
+                    layer=layer,
+                    x=self.x,
+                    q_lora=self.q_lora,
+                    positions=self.pos,
+                    forward_batch=forward_batch,
+                    **({} if row_slice is None else {"row_slice": row_slice}),
+                )
+                after.append(buffers[ratio].clone())
+        return after, backend
+
+
+def _rank_slices(rows, world):
+    return [
+        (*head_a2a_rows(rows, SimpleNamespace(world_size=world, rank_in_group=r)), rows)
+        for r in range(world)
+    ]
+
+
+class TestRowSlicedIndexer(CustomTestCase):
+    def _check(self, mode, num_requests, rows_per_request, world):
+        case = _Case(mode, num_requests, rows_per_request)
+        rows = case.rows
+        for deep_select in (False, True):
+            ref, ref_backend = case.run(deep_select)
+            # The whole-batch run fills every row of every top-k it writes.
+            for out in ref:
+                self.assertFalse((out == UNWRITTEN).any())
+            for start, end, num_rows in _rank_slices(rows, world):
+                with self.subTest(deep_select=deep_select, start=start, end=end):
+                    after, backend = case.run(deep_select, (start, end, num_rows))
+                    real = slice(min(start, rows), min(end, rows))
+                    others = torch.ones(rows, dtype=torch.bool)
+                    others[real] = False
+                    for got, want in zip(after, ref):
+                        torch.testing.assert_close(got[real], want[real])
+                        # The other rows are no rank's here: never written.
+                        self.assertTrue((got[others] == UNWRITTEN).all())
+                    # Every compressor still sees the whole batch.
+                    self.assertEqual(
+                        backend.compressed_rows, [(rows, rows, rows)] * len(LAYERS)
+                    )
+                    # The source published its slice's blocks, which its
+                    # consumer read: the same rows as the whole-batch ones.
+                    published = backend.forward_metadata.candidate_metadata
+                    if real.start == real.stop:
+                        self.assertIsNone(published)
+                    else:
+                        self.assertIsInstance(published, BlockIds)
+                        full_blocks = ref_backend.forward_metadata.candidate_metadata
+                        torch.testing.assert_close(
+                            published.blocks, full_blocks.blocks[real]
+                        )
+
+    def test_verify(self):
+        # 13 requests x 5 draft rows = 65 rows: the last rank's slice is padded.
+        self._check(ForwardMode.TARGET_VERIFY, 13, 5, world=8)
+        self._check(ForwardMode.TARGET_VERIFY, 13, 5, world=4)
+
+    def test_verify_all_pad_ranks(self):
+        # 5 rows over 8 ranks: ranks 5-7 hold padding only and select nothing.
+        self._check(ForwardMode.TARGET_VERIFY, 1, 5, world=8)
+
+    def test_decode(self):
+        self._check(ForwardMode.DECODE, 13, 1, world=8)
+
+    def test_whole_batch_only_paths(self):
+        case = _Case(ForwardMode.DECODE, 13, 1)
+        backend, _ = case.backend(deep_select=False)
+        layer = SimpleNamespace(
+            layer_id=2,
+            compress_ratio=2,
+            indexer=SimpleNamespace(is_candidate_source=False, uses_candidates=False),
+        )
+        # Prefill top-k is never row-sliced.
+        with self.assertRaises(AssertionError):
+            backend._low_ratio_index_topk(
+                layer,
+                case.x,
+                case.q_lora,
+                case.req,
+                case.pos,
+                SimpleNamespace(forward_mode=ForwardMode.EXTEND),
+                row_offset=0,
+            )
+        # DeepGEMM plans its decode for the whole batch.
+        backend.full_topk_indexer.use_deep_gemm_decode = True
+        layer.compressor, layer.indexer = None, object()
+        with (
+            patch.object(deepseek_v4_backend, "dsa_use_prefill_cp", lambda fb: False),
+            self.assertRaises(AssertionError),
+        ):
+            backend.forward_low_ratio_sources(
+                layer=layer,
+                x=case.x,
+                q_lora=case.q_lora,
+                positions=case.pos,
+                forward_batch=SimpleNamespace(
+                    forward_mode=ForwardMode.DECODE, encoder_swa_replay=False
+                ),
+                row_slice=(0, 2, case.rows),
+            )
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()

+    def test_chunk_sequences_read_only_written_late_rows(self):
+        """A forward that runs the late layers writes its tail (last <= window
+        rows) and reads the rows from seq_len - window up to its extend; decode
+        reads the last window. Under the guard every such row was written for any
+        budgets; without it, a short chunk after a skipped one reads rows the
+        skipped chunk never wrote."""
+        page, window = 256, SWA_WINDOW
+        rng = random.Random(0)
+
+        def unwritten_reads(fill, guard):
+            written, start, misses = set(), 0, 0
+            while start < fill:
+                budget = rng.choice((rng.randint(1, 2 * window), rng.randint(1, 4096)))
+                if start == 0:
+                    # A first chunk is cut on a page boundary (PrefillAdder).
+                    ext = fill if fill <= budget else budget // page * page
+                elif guard:
+                    ext = late_tail_safe_chunk_len(
+                        remaining=fill - start, budget=budget, window=window
+                    )
+                else:
+                    ext = budget
+                if ext <= 0:
+                    continue
+                end = min(fill, start + ext)
+                if fill - end < window:
+                    reads = range(max(end - window, 0), start)
+                    misses += sum(row not in written for row in reads)
+                    written.update(range(max(end - window, start), end))
+                start = end
+            decode_reads = range(max(fill - window, 0), fill)
+            return misses + sum(row not in written for row in decode_reads)
+
+        fills = [rng.randint(1, 3000) for _ in range(3000)]
+        self.assertEqual(sum(unwritten_reads(f, guard=True) for f in fills), 0)
+        self.assertGreater(sum(unwritten_reads(f, guard=False) for f in fills), 0)

+import mmap

+@contextmanager
+def _startup_sequence(*, huge_kb: int):
+    """_HostTable's mmap / prefault / cudaHostRegister / smaps steps, faked so a CPU test
+    walks the real startup sequence and records the page-cache drops and collapses."""
+    raw = torch.zeros(8192, dtype=torch.uint8)

+        """With the startup subsystem a per-rank table must neither drop the checkpoint
+        page cache nor force a THP collapse: on TP8 H20 the eight ranks spent minutes
+        in posix_fadvise(DONTNEED) over the 475 GiB checkpoint and the DSpark draft
+        then re-read it from disk. Off, the upstream drop + collapse stay."""
+        for keep, expected in (

+class TestHostTableModuleConversion(CustomTestCase):
+    def _embedding(self, host: bool):

+        embedding.weight = nn.Parameter(

+        )

+        """The gather kernels read the registered host mapping; a parent .half() / .to()

+"""Engram TP split (DeepSeek-V4.1 SM90 mix decode): exchange bookkeeping, mode
+choice and gating (CPU).
+
+Ranks are threads over in-memory collectives; each holds one shard of the table.
+wkv is an elementwise stand-in whose column slices are a rank's columns, and the
+gate kernels are replaced by engram_gate's torch arithmetic, so every split mode
+and every row slice must rebuild the replicated lookup + wkv + gate bit for bit."""
+
+import threading
+import unittest
+from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor
+from functools import partial
+from types import SimpleNamespace
+from unittest.mock import patch
+
+import torch
+
+from sglang.srt.layers import engram as engram_mod
+from sglang.srt.layers.engram import (
+    Engram,
+    EngramEmbedding,
+    _EngramSplit,
+    _tp_split_on,
+    _wkv_splits_bitwise,
+    engram_gate,
+)
+from sglang.srt.model_executor.forward_batch_info import ForwardMode
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_cpu_ci
+from sglang.test.test_utils import CustomTestCase
+
+register_cpu_ci(est_time=6, suite="base-a-test-cpu")
+
+WORLD, HC, DIM, COLS, HEAD_DIM, BLK = 4, 3, 32, 3, 32, 32
+KV_COLS = (HC + 1) * DIM  # 128: one 32-column block per rank
+# Three hash columns of unequal prime sizes; 3 does not divide over 4 ranks, so
+# shard_range takes the equal-row split and one rank owns rows of two columns.
+COLUMN_BOUNDS = (0, 17, 36, 53)
+TABLE_ROWS = COLUMN_BOUNDS[-1]
+IMAGE_ID = 7
+EPS, CLAMP = 1e-6, 1e-6
+
+
+class _Mailbox:
+    def __init__(self):
+        self.slots = [None] * WORLD
+        self.barrier = threading.Barrier(WORLD, timeout=30)
+
+    def exchange(self, rank, tensor):
+        self.slots[rank] = tensor.clone()
+        self.barrier.wait()
+        slots = list(self.slots)
+        self.barrier.wait()
+        return slots
+
+
+class _FakeTp:
+    def __init__(self, box, rank):
+        self.box, self.rank_in_group, self.world_size = box, rank, WORLD
+
+    def all_reduce(self, inp):
+        total = sum(s.float() for s in self.box.exchange(self.rank_in_group, inp))
+        return total.to(inp.dtype)
+
+    def reduce_scatter_tensor(self, out, inp):
+        total = self.all_reduce(inp)
+        n = out.shape[0]
+        out.copy_(total[self.rank_in_group * n : (self.rank_in_group + 1) * n])
+
+    def all_gather_into_tensor(self, out, inp):
+        out.copy_(torch.cat(self.box.exchange(self.rank_in_group, inp)))
+
+    def all_to_all_single(self, out, inp):
+        slots = self.box.exchange(self.rank_in_group, inp)
+        n = inp.numel() // WORLD
+        r = self.rank_in_group
+        out.copy_(torch.cat([s[r * n : (r + 1) * n] for s in slots]))
+
+
+def _table():
+    g = torch.Generator().manual_seed(0)
+    weight = (torch.randn(TABLE_ROWS, HEAD_DIM, generator=g) * 3).to(
+        torch.float8_e4m3fn
+    )
+    scale = torch.randint(
+        110, 135, (TABLE_ROWS, HEAD_DIM // BLK), dtype=torch.uint8, generator=g
+    ).view(torch.float8_e8m0fnu)
+    return weight, scale
+
+
+def _elementwise_linear(
+    input, weight, block_size=None, weight_scale=None, input_scale=None, bias=None
+):
+    """Column n is input column weight[n, 2] scaled by weight[n, 0] and shifted by
+    weight[n, 1]: exact at any row count and for any column slice."""
+    out = input.float()[:, weight[:, 2].long()] * weight[:, 0] + weight[:, 1]
+    return out.to(torch.bfloat16)
+
+
+class _ElementwiseWkv:
+    """Stand-in for the block32 wkv; _wkv_columns slices its weight and scales."""
+
+    def __init__(self):
+        g = torch.Generator().manual_seed(1)
+        k = COLS * HEAD_DIM
+        self.weight = torch.stack(
+            [
+                torch.rand(KV_COLS, generator=g) + 0.5,
+                torch.randn(KV_COLS, generator=g),
+                torch.randint(0, k, (KV_COLS,), generator=g).float(),
+            ],
+            dim=1,
+        )
+        self.weight_scale_inv = torch.ones(KV_COLS // BLK, k // BLK)
+        self.quant_method = SimpleNamespace(
+            w8a8_block_fp8_linear=_elementwise_linear, weight_block_size=[BLK, BLK]
+        )
+
+    def __call__(self, emb_flat):
+        return _elementwise_linear(input=emb_flat, weight=self.weight), None
+
+
+def _pack(x, kv, q_weight, k_weight, eps, clamp_value, out):
+    """engram_gate's torch arithmetic, stored as [value | fp32 gate per hc copy];
+    kv is [rows, cols] or column chunks [chunks, rows, cols / chunks]."""
+    t = x.shape[0]
+    if kv.ndim == 3:
+        kv = kv[:, :t].permute(1, 0, 2).reshape(-1, KV_COLS)
+    kv = kv[:t]
+    key = kv[:, : HC * DIM].float().unflatten(-1, (HC, DIM))
+    h, weight = x.float(), q_weight.float() * k_weight.float()
+    rstd = torch.rsqrt(h.square().mean(-1) + eps) * torch.rsqrt(
+        key.square().mean(-1) + eps
+    )
+    dot = (h * weight * key).sum(-1) * rstd * DIM**-0.5
+    gate = torch.sigmoid(torch.copysign(dot.abs().clamp_min(clamp_value).sqrt(), dot))
+    out[:, :DIM] = kv[:, HC * DIM :]
+    out[:, DIM:].view(torch.float32)[:, :HC] = gate
+    return out
+
+
+def _apply(x, packed, input_ids, image_token_id):
+    gate = packed[:, DIM:].view(torch.float32)[:, :HC]
+    value = packed[:, :DIM].float()
+    out = (x.float() + gate.unsqueeze(-1) * value.unsqueeze(-2)).to(x.dtype)
+    if input_ids is not None:
+        out = torch.where((input_ids == image_token_id)[:, None, None], x, out)
+    return out
+
+
+def _layer(rank, weight, scale, q_weight, k_weight, *, row_split_ok=True):
+    """Rank `rank`'s Engram: its real table shard, the stand-in wkv."""
+    embed = EngramEmbedding(TABLE_ROWS, HEAD_DIM, 1, COLUMN_BOUNDS)
+    embed.weight.weight_loader(embed.weight, weight)
+    embed.scale.weight_loader(embed.scale, scale)
+    layer = Engram.__new__(Engram)
+    torch.nn.Module.__init__(layer)
+    layer.embed, layer.wkv = embed, _ElementwiseWkv()
+    layer.q_weight, layer.k_weight = q_weight, k_weight
+    layer.eps, layer.clamp_value, layer.image_token_id = EPS, CLAMP, IMAGE_ID
+    layer._row_split_ok, layer._col_split_ok = row_split_ok, True
+    return layer
+
+
+def _inputs(rows):
+    torch.manual_seed(rows)
+    x = torch.randn(rows, HC, DIM).to(torch.bfloat16)
+    # The model passes a strided [rows, cols] slice of [rows, n_layers, cols].
+    ids = torch.randint(0, TABLE_ROWS, (rows, 2, COLS))[:, 1]
+    input_ids = torch.randint(0, 12, (rows,))
+    input_ids[::3] = IMAGE_ID
+    q_weight, k_weight = torch.randn(2, HC, DIM).bfloat16()
+    return x, ids, input_ids, q_weight, k_weight
+
+
+def _run_ranks(rank_fn):
+    box, local = _Mailbox(), threading.local()
+
+    def run(rank):
+        local.tp = _FakeTp(box, rank)
+        local.par = SimpleNamespace(
+            tp_size=WORLD, tp_rank=rank, tp_group=local.tp, attn_dp_size=1
+        )
+        return rank_fn(rank)
+
+    with (
+        patch.object(engram_mod, "get_parallel", side_effect=lambda: local.par),
+        patch.object(
+            engram_mod,
+            "tensor_model_parallel_all_reduce",
+            side_effect=lambda t: local.tp.all_reduce(t),
+        ),
+        patch.object(engram_mod, "fused_engram_gate_pack", _pack),
+        patch.object(engram_mod, "fused_engram_gate_apply", _apply),
+    ):
+        with ThreadPoolExecutor(WORLD) as pool:
+            # result() re-raises a rank's exception; the barrier timeout frees the rest.
+            return [f.result() for f in [pool.submit(run, r) for r in range(WORLD)]]
+
+
+def _reference(x, ids, input_ids, q_weight, k_weight):
+    """The replicated path: whole table on one rank, every row projected and gated."""
+    weight, scale = _table()
+    kv, _ = _ElementwiseWkv()(_dequant(weight, scale, ids).flatten(-2))
+    return engram_gate(
+        x, kv, q_weight, k_weight, EPS, CLAMP, input_ids, image_token_id=IMAGE_ID
+    )
+
+
+def _bits(t):
+    return t.view(torch.int16)
+
+
+def _dequant(weight, scale, ids):
+    rows = weight[ids].float().unflatten(-1, (-1, BLK))
+    return (rows * scale[ids].float().unsqueeze(-1)).flatten(-2).to(torch.bfloat16)
+
+
+class TestEngramSplitExchange(CustomTestCase):
+    def test_every_mode_rebuilds_the_replicated_rows_on_every_rank(self):
+        # Divisible, uneven, and fewer rows than ranks (some ranks own none);
+        # every third row is an image token and must keep x.
+        for mode in _EngramSplit:
+            for rows in (64, 65, 102, 5, 1):
+                with self.subTest(mode=mode.name, rows=rows):
+                    x, ids, input_ids, qw, kw = _inputs(rows)
+                    weight, scale = _table()
+
+                    def rank_fn(rank):
+                        layer = _layer(rank, weight, scale, qw, kw)
+                        return layer._forward_split(
+                            x, ids, input_ids=input_ids, mode=mode
+                        )
+
+                    ref = _reference(x, ids, input_ids, qw, kw)
+                    self.assertTrue(torch.equal(_bits(ref[::3]), _bits(x[::3])))
+                    for rank, out in enumerate(_run_ranks(rank_fn)):
+                        self.assertTrue(
+                            torch.equal(_bits(out), _bits(ref)), f"rank {rank}"
+                        )
+
+    def test_row_slices_rebuild_the_replicated_rows(self):
+        """forward_row_slice on each rank's [start, start + chunk) rows, with padding
+        rows past the batch (a rank whose slice is all padding included), with the
+        row-invariant lookup slice and with the project-every-row fallback."""
+        for row_split_ok in (True, False):
+            for rows, chunk in ((64, 16), (65, 17), (5, 2), (3, 1)):
+                with self.subTest(row_split_ok=row_split_ok, rows=rows, chunk=chunk):
+                    x, ids, input_ids, qw, kw = _inputs(rows)
+                    weight, scale = _table()
+                    x_pad = torch.cat([x, torch.randn(chunk * WORLD - rows, HC, DIM)])
+                    x_pad = x_pad.to(torch.bfloat16)
+
+                    def rank_fn(rank):
+                        layer = _layer(
+                            rank, weight, scale, qw, kw, row_split_ok=row_split_ok
+                        )
+                        start = rank * chunk
+                        return layer.forward_row_slice(
+                            x_pad[start : start + chunk].clone(),
+                            ids,
+                            start=start,
+                            chunk=chunk,
+                            world=WORLD,
+                            input_ids=input_ids,
+                        )
+
+                    out = torch.cat(_run_ranks(rank_fn))
+                    ref = _reference(x, ids, input_ids, qw, kw)
+                    self.assertTrue(torch.equal(_bits(out[:rows]), _bits(ref)))
+                    self.assertTrue(torch.equal(_bits(out[rows:]), _bits(x_pad[rows:])))
+
+
+def _mode(rows, *, row_ok=True, col_ok=True):
+    layer = SimpleNamespace(_row_split_ok=row_ok, _col_split_ok=col_ok)
+    layer._wkv_split_ok = partial(Engram._wkv_split_ok, layer)
+    x = SimpleNamespace(
+        shape=(rows, HC, DIM),
+        is_cuda=True,
+        dtype=torch.bfloat16,
+        is_contiguous=lambda: True,
+    )
+    fb = SimpleNamespace(forward_mode=ForwardMode.DECODE)
+    return Engram._split_mode(layer, x, fb)
+
+
+class TestEngramSplitMode(CustomTestCase):
+    def test_mode_by_row_count(self):
+        # H20-3e TP4 measurements: column all-gather below 64 rows, column
+        # all-to-all up to 512, the row split from 65 rows otherwise.
+        S = _EngramSplit
+        self.assertEqual(_mode(1), S.COL_GATHER)
+        self.assertEqual(_mode(63), S.COL_GATHER)
+        self.assertEqual(_mode(64), S.COL_A2A)
+        self.assertEqual(_mode(512), S.COL_A2A)
+        self.assertEqual(_mode(513), S.ROW)
+        # wkv columns not splittable: the row split from 65 rows, else replicated.
+        self.assertIsNone(_mode(64, col_ok=False))
+        self.assertEqual(_mode(65, col_ok=False), S.ROW)
+        self.assertIsNone(_mode(513, row_ok=False))
+        self.assertIsNone(_mode(384, row_ok=False, col_ok=False))

+the TP-SP row slice are bitwise the replicated Engram, eager and in CUDA graphs.

+wkv is the checkpoint's [32, 32]-block ue8m0 FP8 linear (25600 x 6144) through
+Fp8LinearMethod with the SM90 switch on for role mix, so the device's block32

+from types import SimpleNamespace

+from sglang.srt.layers.dsv41_sm90 import SUBSYSTEMS

+HC, HIDDEN, NGRAM, HEADS, HEAD_DIM = 4, 5120, 4, 8, 256
+COLS = (NGRAM - 1) * HEADS
+IMAGE_ID = 129264

+COLUMN_SIZES = tuple(150 + 7 * c for c in range(COLS))
+ROWS = (6, 18, 48, 63, 64, 65, 96, 186, 192, 384, 512)

+def tp():

+def _layout_env(layout: str) -> ExitStack:
+    stack = ExitStack()
+    stack.enter_context(
+        envs.SGLANG_OPT_DSV41_ENGRAM_PEER_SHARDS.override(layout == "peer")
+    )
+    host = layout in ("shared", "per_rank")

+    if host:

+    return stack

+def _build_engram(layout: str) -> Engram:
+    """An Engram with checkpoint-like weights, identical on every rank, loaded and
+    post-processed like the model's."""
+    table_rows = sum(COLUMN_SIZES)
+    engram_layout = EngramLayout(
+        max_ngram_size=NGRAM,
+        layer_ids=(1,),
+        num_embeddings=(table_rows,),
+        primes=(
+            tuple(COLUMN_SIZES[i * HEADS : (i + 1) * HEADS] for i in range(NGRAM - 1)),
+        ),
+        n_heads=HEADS,

+        scale_fmt="ue8m0",

+        110, 135, (table_rows, HEAD_DIM // 32), device="cuda", generator=g

+def _fill_inputs(x, ids, input_ids, seed: int) -> None:
+    """Fresh rows, the same on every rank; every fifth row is an image token."""
+    g = torch.Generator(device="cuda").manual_seed(seed)
+    x.copy_(torch.randn(x.shape, device="cuda", generator=g) * 3)
+    bounds = torch.tensor((0, *COLUMN_SIZES), device="cuda").cumsum(0)
+    u = torch.rand(ids.shape, device="cuda", generator=g, dtype=torch.float64)
+    span = (bounds[1:] - bounds[:-1]).double()
+    ids.copy_(bounds[:-1] + (u * span).long())
+    input_ids.copy_(torch.randint(0, 1000, input_ids.shape, generator=g, device="cuda"))
+    input_ids[::5] = IMAGE_ID
+
+
+def _replicated(engram, x, ids, input_ids, forward_batch):
+    engram.tp_split = False
+    try:
+        return engram(x, ids, forward_batch, input_ids=input_ids)
+    finally:
+        engram.tp_split = True
+
+
+def _bits(t):
+    return t.view(torch.int16)
+
+
+def _split_outputs(engram, x, x_slice, ids, input_ids, *, start, chunk, world):
+    outs = [
+        engram._forward_split(x, ids, input_ids=input_ids, mode=mode)
+        for mode in _EngramSplit
+    ]
+    outs.append(
+        engram.forward_row_slice(
+            x_slice, ids, start=start, chunk=chunk, world=world, input_ids=input_ids
+        )
+    )
+    return outs
+
+
+def _check(outs, ref, x_slice, *, start, rows, where):
+    for mode, out in zip(_EngramSplit, outs[:-1]):
+        assert torch.equal(_bits(out), _bits(ref)), f"{where} {mode.name}"
+    local = max(0, min(x_slice.shape[0], rows - start))
+    row_slice = outs[-1]
+    assert torch.equal(_bits(row_slice[:local]), _bits(ref[start : start + local])), (
+        f"{where} row slice"
+    )
+    assert torch.equal(_bits(row_slice[local:]), _bits(x_slice[local:])), (
+        f"{where} row slice padding"
+    )
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("layout", LAYOUTS)
+def test_split_matches_replicated_eager_and_graph(tp, layout):
+    world, rank = tp.world_size, tp.rank_in_group
+    engram = _build_engram(layout)
+    assert engram.tp_split and engram._wkv_split_ok(columns=True)
+    verify = SimpleNamespace(
+        forward_mode=ForwardMode.TARGET_VERIFY, engram_staged_rows=None
+    )
+    for rows in ROWS:
+        where = f"tp{world} rank {rank} {layout} rows {rows}"
+        # The model passes a strided [rows, cols] slice of [rows, n_layers, cols].
+        ids = torch.empty(rows, 2, COLS, dtype=torch.int64, device="cuda")[:, 1]
+        x = torch.empty(rows, HC, HIDDEN, dtype=torch.bfloat16, device="cuda")
+        input_ids = torch.empty(rows, dtype=torch.int64, device="cuda")
+        # TP-SP pads the batch to world * chunk rows; padding keeps its rows.
+        chunk = -(-rows // world)
+        start = rank * chunk
+        x_slice = torch.randn(chunk, HC, HIDDEN, device="cuda").bfloat16()
+        _fill_inputs(x, ids, input_ids, seed=rows)
+        x_slice[: max(0, min(chunk, rows - start))] = x[start : start + chunk]
+
+        ref = _replicated(engram, x, ids, input_ids, verify)
+        assert torch.equal(
+            _bits(engram(x, ids, verify, input_ids=input_ids)), _bits(ref)
+        )
+        outs = _split_outputs(
+            engram, x, x_slice, ids, input_ids, start=start, chunk=chunk, world=world
+        )
+        _check(outs, ref, x_slice, start=start, rows=rows, where=f"{where} eager")
+
+        graph = torch.cuda.CUDAGraph()
+        with ps.graph_capture() as context:
+            for _ in range(2):
+                _split_outputs(
+                    engram,
+                    x,
+                    x_slice,
+                    ids,
+                    input_ids,
+                    start=start,
+                    chunk=chunk,
+                    world=world,
+                )
+            context.stream.synchronize()
+            with torch.cuda.graph(graph, stream=context.stream):
+                captured = _split_outputs(
+                    engram,
+                    x,
+                    x_slice,
+                    ids,
+                    input_ids,
+                    start=start,
+                    chunk=chunk,
+                    world=world,
+                )
+        _fill_inputs(x, ids, input_ids, seed=rows + 1)
+        x_slice[: max(0, min(chunk, rows - start))] = x[start : start + chunk]
+        graph.replay()
+        torch.cuda.synchronize()
+        ref = _replicated(engram, x, ids, input_ids, verify)
+        _check(captured, ref, x_slice, start=start, rows=rows, where=f"{where} graph")
+        del graph

+def _fingerprint(
+    model_path="/models/a", revision=None, dtype=torch.bfloat16, dims=None
+):
+    return model_fingerprint(
+        model_path=model_path,
+        revision=revision,
+        dtype=dtype,
+        dims_by_modality=dims or {"IMAGE": 4096, "AUDIO": 2048},
+    )
+
+
+def _buffer(nbytes, byte=0x78):
+    buf = ctypes.create_string_buffer(bytes([byte]) * nbytes, nbytes)
+    return buf, ctypes.addressof(buf)
+
+
+def _put(store, key, nbytes, byte=0x78):
+    _buf, ptr = _buffer(nbytes, byte)
+    return store.batch_put_from_multi_buffers([key], [[ptr]], [[nbytes]]) == [True]
+
+
+def _get(store, key, nbytes):
+    out = ctypes.create_string_buffer(nbytes)
+    hit = store.batch_get_into_multi_buffers(
+        [key], [[ctypes.addressof(out)]], [[nbytes]]
+    )
+    return hit == [True], out.raw
+
+
+def _dead_pid():
+    proc = subprocess.Popen([sys.executable, "-c", "pass"])
+    proc.wait()
+    return proc.pid
+
+
+def _count_scans(store):
+    scans = {"n": 0}
+    scan_dir = store._scan_dir
+
+    def counted():
+        scans["n"] += 1
+        return scan_dir()
+
+    store._scan_dir = counted
+    return scans

+        the most recent, so the next overflow evicts the other one."""

+        _a2, p2 = _buffer(half, 0x22)

+        )
+        self.assertEqual(hit, [True])
+        self.assertEqual((o1.raw, o2.raw), (b"\x11" * half, b"\x22" * half))
+        time.sleep(0.02)
+        self.assertTrue(_put(self.store, "c", D))

+"""Decode CUDA graph batch sizes under CP decode attention TP (V4.1, TP8 + prefill CP8)."""
+
+from types import SimpleNamespace
+
+import pytest
+
+from sglang.srt.layers.cp import base as cp_base
+from sglang.srt.layers.cp import padding
+from sglang.srt.model_executor.runner.base_cuda_graph_runner import (
+    get_batch_sizes_to_capture,
+)
+from sglang.srt.runtime_context import get_context, get_flags
+from sglang.srt.utils import common
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_cpu_ci
+
+register_cpu_ci(est_time=2, suite="base-a-test-cpu")
+
+_CAPTURE_BS = [1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 12, 16, 24, 32, 48, 64]
+# DSpark block size 5: one verify forward is 6 rows per request.
+_VERIFY_ROWS_PER_REQ = 6
+
+
+def _tp8_cp8(**overrides):
+    # TP8 with prefill CP8 and CP decode attention TP, no DP attention.
+    fields = dict(
+        enable_cp_decode_attn_tp=True,
+        attn_cp_size=8,
+        attn_tp_size=1,
+        attn_dp_size=1,
+    )
+    fields.update(overrides)
+    return SimpleNamespace(**fields)
+
+
+@pytest.fixture
+def capture(monkeypatch):
+    override = get_context().override_server_args(
+        cuda_graph_config=SimpleNamespace(
+            decode=SimpleNamespace(backend="default", bs=list(_CAPTURE_BS))
+        ),
+        enable_torch_compile=False,
+        enable_two_batch_overlap=False,
+    )
+    override.install()
+    model_runner = SimpleNamespace(
+        server_args=SimpleNamespace(model_impl="auto", dllm_algorithm=None),
+        req_to_token_pool=SimpleNamespace(size=64),
+    )
+
+    def run(*, parallel, subsystems=frozenset({"mix_decode"}), role="mix", kind=None):
+        monkeypatch.setattr(common, "get_parallel", lambda: parallel)
+        monkeypatch.setattr(padding, "get_parallel", lambda: parallel)
+        monkeypatch.setattr(
+            cp_base,
+            "get_cp_strategy_kind",
+            lambda: kind or cp_base.ContextParallelStrategyKind.INTERLEAVE,
+        )
+        with get_flags().dsv41_sm90.override(subsystems=subsystems, role=role):
+            capture_bs, _ = get_batch_sizes_to_capture(
+                model_runner, _VERIFY_ROWS_PER_REQ, gathered_buffer_required=False
+            )
+        return capture_bs
+
+    try:
+        yield run
+    finally:
+        override.restore()
+
+
+def test_mix_decode_keeps_logical_batch_sizes(capture):
+    """A single request must replay a bs=1 graph, not the bs=4 one (24 rows)."""
+    assert capture(parallel=_tp8_cp8()) == _CAPTURE_BS
+
+
+def test_other_selections_keep_the_cp_alignment(capture):
+    # 6 rows per request: bs * 6 % 8 == 0 only for multiples of 4.
+    aligned = [bs for bs in _CAPTURE_BS if bs % 4 == 0]
+    for kwargs in (
+        dict(subsystems=frozenset(), role=""),
+        dict(subsystems=frozenset({"cp", "decode"})),
+        dict(role="decode"),
+        dict(role="prefill"),
+        dict(parallel=_tp8_cp8(enable_cp_decode_attn_tp=False)),
+        dict(parallel=_tp8_cp8(attn_dp_size=2)),
+        dict(parallel=_tp8_cp8(attn_tp_size=2)),
+        dict(kind=cp_base.ContextParallelStrategyKind.ZIGZAG),
+    ):
+        kwargs.setdefault("parallel", _tp8_cp8())
+        assert capture(**kwargs) == aligned, kwargs
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    raise SystemExit(pytest.main([__file__, "-v"]))

+class _DeviceLens(torch.Tensor):
+    """Lengths that fail the step if read on the host (a device->host wait)."""
+
+    def tolist(self):
+        raise AssertionError("draft block prep copied the device lengths")
+
+
+class TestUnGluedDraftBlockPrep(CustomTestCase):
+    def _prep(self, backend, seq_lens):
+        seen = {}
+        backend._draft_block_extend_lens = lambda lens: torch.tensor(lens)
+        backend.init_forward_metadata_prefill = lambda **kw: seen.update(kw)
+        backend.page_size = 256
+        backend.init_forward_metadata_dspark_draft_block(
+            max_seq_len=1 << 20,
+            req_pool_indices=torch.arange(2),
+            seq_lens=seq_lens,
+            seq_lens_cpu=None,
+            out_cache_loc=torch.zeros(10, dtype=torch.int64),
+            block_size=5,
+        )
+        return seen
+
+    def test_switch_on_reads_no_host_lengths(self):
+        """Under prefill CP the glue is off, and the per-step host copy of the draft
+        lengths waited for the last verify on every decode step (no CPU run-ahead).
+        Under the switch the prep must use the device lengths only."""
+        backend = _backend(sm90_decode=True)
+        seq_lens = torch.tensor([100, 7]).as_subclass(_DeviceLens)
+        seen = self._prep(backend, seq_lens)
+        self.assertIsNone(seen["seq_lens_cpu"])
+        self.assertEqual(seen["extend_seq_lens_cpu"], [5, 5])
+        self.assertEqual(seen["num_tokens"], 10)
+        self.assertEqual(seen["seq_lens"].as_subclass(torch.Tensor).tolist(), [105, 12])
+        # Off: the upstream host copy.
+        seen = self._prep(_backend(sm90_decode=False), torch.tensor([100, 7]))
+        self.assertEqual(seen["seq_lens_cpu"], [105, 12])
+

+        torch.nn.Module.__init__(model)
+        model.wo_a_fp8 = False
+        model.logits_processor = SimpleNamespace(use_fp8_lm_head=False)
+        model.pp_group = SimpleNamespace(is_last_rank=True)

+        patches = (
+            mock.patch.object(ap, "load_block32_routes", return_value="routes"),
+            mock.patch.object(ap, "get_stream", side_effect=lambda name: name),
+            mock.patch("torch.cuda.get_device_name", return_value="NVIDIA H20"),
+            mock.patch.object(ap.deep_gemm_wrapper, "ENABLE_JIT_DEEPGEMM", True),
+        )

+            patch.start()

+    def _resolve(self, *, subsystems=("attn_proj",), role="mix", **kwargs):

+        with mock.patch.object(ap.deep_gemm_wrapper, "ENABLE_JIT_DEEPGEMM", False):
+            plan, loader = self._resolve()
+            self.assertFalse(plan.wo_a_fp8_block32 or loader)
+
+    def test_draft_keeps_its_bf16_wo_a_but_still_rounds(self):
+        # The DSpark draft pins wo_a to bf16 (its loader dequantizes); the plan
+        # exists, so its input still takes the V4.1 rounding.
+        plan, _ = self._resolve(fp8_wo_a_allowed=False)
+        self.assertIsNotNone(plan)
+        self.assertFalse(plan.wo_a_fp8_block32)
+        self.assertEqual(plan.streams, ())
+
+    def test_decode_role_fusions(self):
+        for role in ("mix", "prefill", "decode"):
+            with self.subTest(role=role):
+                plan, _ = self._resolve(role=role)
+                self.assertEqual(plan.decode_rope_rows, role == "decode")
+                self.assertEqual(plan.kv_store_q_rope, role == "decode")
+        # The bf16-sourced K store rejects a query to rope.

+

+"""The CP-local router of the DeepSeek-V4.1 CP prefill MoE (deepseek_v4_cp_prefill)."""
+
+import unittest
+from types import SimpleNamespace
+from unittest.mock import patch
+
+import torch
+
+from sglang.srt.layers.moe.topk import StandardTopKOutput
+from sglang.srt.models import deepseek_v4_cp_prefill as cp_prefill
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_cpu_ci
+from sglang.test.test_utils import CustomTestCase
+
+register_cpu_ci(est_time=5, suite="base-a-test-cpu")
+
+TOP_K = 6
+
+
+IMAGE_TOKEN = 3
+
+
+class _Gate:
+    def __init__(self, *, vision: bool, seen: list):
+        self.seen = seen
+        # Only its presence matters to the CP prefill; vision_topk reads it.
+        self.e_score_correction_bias_vl = torch.zeros(8) if vision else None
+
+    def __call__(self, x):
+        self.seen.append(x.shape[0])
+        return x[:, :8].float() * 3 - 1
+
+
+def _top_k(logits):
+    weights, ids = logits.topk(TOP_K, dim=1)
+    return StandardTopKOutput(weights.float(), ids.to(torch.int32), logits)
+
+
+def _vision_topk(moe, logits, input_ids):
+    """vision_topk stand-in: image-token rows take another expert bias."""
+    image = (input_ids == IMAGE_TOKEN)[:, None]
+    return _top_k(logits + image * torch.arange(8).float())
+
+
+def _row_router(*, is_hash: bool, vision: bool, seen: list):
+    """A router that is a function of each row alone (and of its token id when
+    hash-routed or VL-biased), recording the rows it was given."""
+
+    def topk(x, logits, input_ids=None):
+        if input_ids is not None:
+            logits = logits + input_ids[:, None].float()
+        return _top_k(logits)
+
+    return SimpleNamespace(
+        gate=_Gate(vision=vision, seen=seen), topk=topk, is_hash=is_hash
+    )
+
+
+def _gathered_routing(mlp, gathered, ids_global):
+    """How DeepseekV2MoE.forward_normal routes the gathered rows."""
+    logits = mlp.gate(gathered)
+    if mlp.gate.e_score_correction_bias_vl is not None:
+        return _vision_topk(mlp, logits, ids_global)
+    return mlp.topk(
+        gathered, logits, **({"input_ids": ids_global} if mlp.is_hash else {})
+    )
+
+
+class TestCpLocalRouter(CustomTestCase):
+    def test_side_payload_round_trips_ids_and_weight_bits(self):
+        ids = torch.randint(0, 384, (37, TOP_K), dtype=torch.int32)
+        weights = torch.randn(37, TOP_K)
+        weights[0, 0] = -0.0
+        weights[1, 1] = float("nan")
+        got = cp_prefill._unpack_topk(cp_prefill._pack_topk(ids, weights), TOP_K)
+        self.assertTrue(torch.equal(got.topk_ids, ids))
+        self.assertTrue(
+            torch.equal(got.topk_weights.view(torch.int32), weights.view(torch.int32))
+        )
+
+    def test_repeated_rows_route_like_the_gathered_rank_block(self):
+        """Rows repeated up to the validated GEMM row count, and the rank's block of
+        the rank-major token ids, must give exactly this rank's rows of the
+        gathered routing, also on the VL-biased layers of a checkpoint with a
+        vision tower; the repeated rows' top-k must not survive."""
+        cp, rank, rows = 4, 2, 5
+        gathered = torch.randn(cp * rows, 16)
+        ids_global = torch.arange(cp * rows) * 7 % 11
+        for is_hash, vision in ((False, False), (True, False), (False, True)):
+            with self.subTest(is_hash=is_hash, vision=vision):
+                seen = []
+                mlp = _row_router(is_hash=is_hash, vision=vision, seen=seen)
+                full = _gathered_routing(mlp, gathered, ids_global)
+                parallel = SimpleNamespace(attn_cp_size=cp, attn_cp_rank=rank)
+                with (
+                    patch.object(cp_prefill, "get_parallel", return_value=parallel),
+                    patch.object(cp_prefill, "vision_topk", _vision_topk),
+                ):
+                    ids, weights = cp_prefill._route_local_rows(
+                        mlp,
+                        gathered[rank * rows : (rank + 1) * rows],
+                        ids_global,
+                        route_rows=2 * rows,
+                    )
+                own = slice(rank * rows, (rank + 1) * rows)
+                self.assertEqual(seen[-1], 2 * rows)
+                self.assertTrue(torch.equal(ids, full.topk_ids[own]))
+                self.assertTrue(torch.equal(weights, full.topk_weights[own]))
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()
